title: Research Engineer, Coding Agents
description:
About Turing

Turing builds large-scale datasets and reinforcement learning (RL) environments that power post-training for the world's leading AI labs and enterprises, including OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind, Microsoft AI, Amazon, Apple, and many more. We create RL environments to evaluate and improve our customers' models on complex, multi-step workflows across high-value domains — designing the tasks, reward signals, and verifiers that drive measurable model improvement through RL training.


The Role

We are looking for a Research Engineer, Coding Agents to help deliver frontier-quality datasets, RL environments, and evaluations that improve state-of-the-art coding models and software engineering agents for leading AI labs and enterprise clients.

This is a hands-on, research-facing technical role. You will work directly with customer researchers and engineers to turn their coding agent improvement goals into concrete data and environment specs — designing tasks that reflect real software engineering work and building the ground-truth systems that verify agent performance.


We're targeting candidates with roughly 4–5 years of experience, ideally combining strong software engineering fundamentals with exposure to ML/AI systems — especially where results depended on data quality, evaluation rigor, or building infrastructure that other engineers rely on.


What You'll Do:

1. Design and deliver datasets and RL environments for coding agents

  • Work with customer researchers to define data requirements for coding agent capabilities: codebase navigation, bug localization, patching, test generation, code reviews, CI-like constraints, refactors, and security fixes.
  • Design task suites that reflect real development work — single-step tasks (fix this bug, write this test) through long-horizon workflows (navigate an unfamiliar repo, diagnose a multi-file issue, produce a reviewed PR).
  • Build ground-truth signals: unit tests, structured checks, automatic validators, and reward functions that verify whether an agent's code actually works.
  • Define environment interfaces — repository structures, dependency contexts, tool schemas — that give agents realistic constraints.


2. Build the quality and validation systems that ensure frontier-grade data

  • Perform deep, detail-oriented audits of produced data — spotting subtle errors, reward hacking opportunities (e.g., agents gaming test suites), leakage, and inconsistent assumptions.
  • Implement automated validation and filtering: deduplication, decontamination, consistency checks, and difficulty/diversity controls.
  • Where appropriate, develop synthetic task generation pipelines: programmatic bug injection, controlled perturbations to existing codebases, and scenario templating across languages and frameworks.


3. Prove impact through evaluations and training runs

  • Design and run evals aligned with coding benchmarks and customer-defined capability targets.
  • Produce analysis connecting data to outcomes: pre/post comparisons on targeted coding tasks, error breakdowns, and ablations identifying which data attributes drive model lift on SWE tasks.
  • When needed, run fine-tuning or RL experiments (or partner with research) to demonstrate measurable coding agent improvement.


4. Collaborate with cross-functional delivery teams

  • Provide clear specs, examples, and edge cases to engineers, QAs, and large-scale data production groups.
  • Run fast feedback loops grounded in code quality metrics and automated signals.
  • Review and improve outputs from large-scale task creation efforts, maintaining a high bar for realism and correctness.


Who We're Looking For:

1. Required Qualifications

  • 4–5 years of professional software engineering or ML engineering experience.
  • Python proficiency required; proficiency in one or more additional major languages (C++, Java, Go, Rust, JS/TS) strongly preferred.
  • Strong intuition for what makes a good coding task — realistic difficulty, clear ground truth, and resistance to shortcut solutions.
  • Demonstrated ability to be extremely detail-oriented: you catch bugs in code that automated tools miss.
  • Experience with testing infrastructure, CI/CD, or code quality systems at a meaningful scale.
  • Ability to communicate clearly with researchers and engineers — turning model improvement goals into concrete task specs.


2. Highly valued experience

  • Experience building or evaluating coding agents, copilot systems, or AI-assisted development tools.
  • Familiarity with coding benchmarks (SWE-Bench, HumanEval, or equivalent).
  • RL or post-training work: RLHF, reward modeling, verifier training, or environment design.
  • Experience designing or maintaining evaluation harnesses for ML systems.
  • Comfort with SQL and structured data workflows


Why Turing

  • Work directly with the world's leading AI labs on the RL environments powering post-training for frontier models.
  • Real impact: your environments and reward systems will directly shape how models learn to reason, act, and improve.
  • Talent-dense team with high autonomy, rapid iteration, and an exceptional learning curve.


Values:

  • We are client first : We put our clients at the center of everything we do, because their success is the ultimate measure of our value.
  • We work at Start-Up Speed: We move fast, stay agile and favor action because momentum is the foundation of perfection
  • We are Al forward: We help our clients build the future of Al and implement it in our own roles and workflow to amplify productivity.


Advantages of joining Turing:

  • Amazing work culture (Super collaborative & supportive work environment; 5 days a week)
  • Awesome colleagues (Surround yourself with top talent from Meta, Google, LinkedIn etc. as well as people with deep startup experience)
  • Competitive compensation
  • Flexible working hours


Don’t meet every single requirement?

Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. Turing is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristics. At Turing we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace and celebrate authenticity, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

title: Research Engineer, Multimodal
description:
The Role

We are looking for a Research Engineer, Multimodal to help deliver frontier-quality multimodal datasets, evaluations, and RL environments that improve state-of-the-art models for leading AI labs and enterprise clients.


This is a hands-on, research-facing technical role. You will work directly with customer researchers and engineers to turn their multimodal model improvement goals into concrete data specs — designing tasks that test genuine cross-modal reasoning, not just text comprehension with images attached.


We're targeting candidates with roughly 4–5 years of experience building or improving multimodal AI systems — especially where strong results depended on data curation across modalities, evaluation design, or building systems that handle the complexity of real-world documents, charts, and visual interfaces.


What You'll Do

1. Design and deliver multimodal datasets and evaluation environments

  • Work with customer researchers to define data requirements for multimodal capabilities: chart reading, document QA, UI understanding, diagram-based reasoning, OCR-aware tasks, and visual grounding.
  • Design task suites that test true multimodal reasoning — tasks where the answer requires integrating information across text, images, tables, and document structure, not just surface-level pattern matching.
  • Build ground-truth signals and verification systems for multimodal tasks, where correctness often depends on spatial relationships, visual context, and cross-reference between modalities.
  • Define task formats and data schemas that capture the full richness of multimodal inputs while remaining tractable for model training.


2. Build quality and validation systems for multimodal data

  • Perform deep audits of produced data — spotting subtle errors in visual grounding, incorrect chart readings, OCR artifacts, layout misinterpretations, and ambiguous visual references.
  • Implement automated validation: consistency checks across modalities, format and schema validation, deduplication, and difficulty/diversity controls.
  • Where appropriate, develop synthetic data generation pipelines: programmatic chart/table generation, document layout templating, controlled visual perturbations, and augmentation across visual conditions.

3. Prove impact through evaluations and training runs

  • Design and run evals targeting multimodal capabilities aligned with customer goals.
  • Produce analysis connecting data to outcomes: pre/post comparisons on targeted multimodal tasks, error breakdowns by modality and task type, and ablations identifying which data attributes drive model lift.
  • When needed, run fine-tuning or RL experiments (or partner with research) to demonstrate measurable multimodal improvement.

4. Collaborate with cross-functional delivery teams

  • Provide clear specs, visual examples, and edge cases to engineers, QAs, domain SMEs, and data production groups.
  • Run fast feedback loops grounded in multimodal quality metrics.
  • Review and improve outputs from large-scale multimodal data creation efforts, maintaining a high bar for cross-modal correctness and realism.


Who We're Looking For

1. Required Qualifications

  • 4–5 years of experience building or improving AI systems involving multimodal data — images, documents, charts, tables, or visual interfaces combined with text.
  • Hands-on experience with at least one of: document understanding, chart/diagram reasoning, OCR systems, UI understanding, or vision-language models.
  • Strong intuition for what makes a good multimodal task: genuine cross-modal reasoning requirements, clear ground truth, and resistance to text-only shortcuts.
  • Demonstrated ability to be extremely detail-oriented — you catch when a chart label is misread, a table cell is misaligned, or a visual reference is ambiguous.
  • Python proficiency required; comfort with SQL and structured data workflows strongly preferred.
  • Ability to communicate clearly with researchers and engineers — turning multimodal model goals into concrete data specs.


2. Highly valued experience

  • RL or post-training experience: RLHF/RLAIF, reward modeling, verifier training, or environment design applied to multimodal tasks.
  • Experience with vision-language models (CLIP, LLaVA, GPT-4V, Gemini, or equivalent).
  • Agentic evaluation involving visual grounding: browser-use agents, UI navigation, or screen-based task completion.
  • Experience building evaluation frameworks or benchmarks for multimodal systems.
  • Audio/video understanding experience (optional but valued).


Why Turing

  • Work directly with the world's leading AI labs on the multimodal datasets and evaluations training the next generation of vision-language models.
  • Real impact: your data will directly shape how models learn to read charts, understand documents, navigate interfaces, and reason across modalities.
  • Talent-dense team with high autonomy, rapid iteration, and an exceptional learning curve.

  • We work at Start-Up Speed: We move fast, stay agile and favor action because momentum is the foundation of perfection

Successfully navigating these situations—through transparency, risk anticipation, sound judgment, and resolution under pressure—is a critical aspect of the role.

  • criteria with stakeholder

title: ServiceNow Applications Engineer

Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.

A equipe de Analytics de BMP (Business Model and Pricing) está em busca de um(a) Analista de Dados experiente para apoiar a gestão de performance do negócio e a tomada de decisões estratégicas por meio de análises avançadas. A equipe atua em parceria próxima com liderança, finanças, operações e stakeholders de negócio para mensurar o desempenho das nossas ofertas aos clientes, gerar insights sobre o comportamento dos clientes e impulsionar ações orientadas por dados em toda a organização.

Esta função exige forte rigor analítico, visão de negócio e capacidade de comunicar insights de forma clara para stakeholders seniores.


O(a) candidato(a) ideal possui histórico comprovado de entrega de análises de alto impacto em ambientes dinâmicos e multifuncionais, além de estar confortável equilibrando análises estruturadas e recorrentes com demandas ad hoc que apoiam prioridades de negócio em constante evolução.


O que você fará

  • Aplicar forte mentalidade analítica e de resolução de problemas para identificar questões de negócio, lacunas de performance e oportunidades de melhoria, traduzindo-as em abordagens analíticas claras.

  • Projetar, desenvolver e manter dashboards, relatórios e modelos analíticos para acompanhar a performance em relação às metas e apoiar a tomada de decisão da liderança.
  • Conduzir análises ad hoc e aprofundadas para explicar tendências, variações, riscos e oportunidades, além de avaliar o impacto de iniciativas de negócio.
  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com stakeholders para entender objetivos, definir métricas relevantes e garantir que as entregas analíticas estejam alinhadas às necessidades de decisão.
  • Atuar em parceria com as equipes de engenharia de dados, finanças e outros times de analytics para garantir qualidade, consistência e escalabilidade das soluções de reporte.
  • Sintetizar análises complexas em narrativas claras e objetivas, apresentando resultados que traduzam dados em insights acionáveis para a liderança sênior.
  • Contribuir para a melhoria contínua de frameworks analíticos, ferramentas e melhores práticas dentro da equipe de BMP Analytics.


Qualificações Mínimas

  • Mestrado em Analytics, Ciência de Dados, Economia, Estatística, Engenharia, Administração ou área quantitativa relacionada.
  • Mais de 5 anos de experiência em análise de dados, analytics de negócio ou gestão de performance.
  • Experiência sólida com SQL e pelo menos uma linguagem de programação analítica (Python ou equivalente).
  • Experiência na construção de dashboards e relatórios utilizando ferramentas de BI (preferencialmente Power BI).
  • Forte pensamento analítico, com capacidade comprovada de estruturar problemas ambíguos.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e apresentação, com capacidade de engajar públicos técnicos e não técnicos.
  • Capacidade comprovada de colaboração eficaz em equipes multifuncionais.
  • Inglês fluente.


Qualificações Desejáveis

title: Investment Banking Intern
description:
Investment Banking Internship - WSO Global Talent Program

Our Global Talent Program offers an unparalleled opportunity to gain hands-on experience and build a formidable resume through an immersive, 10-week virtual internship.


We are actively screening thousands of top students globally to identify future finance leaders. This highly selective program is offered in partnership with leading boutique investment banks in key markets, including the US, UK, APAC, Europe, MENA markets.

Since its foundation in 2001, Matrix has made more travelers and acquisitions and has executed some of the largest, most significant. The company specializes in implementing and developing leading technologies, software solutions, and products. It provides its customers with infrastructure and consulting services, IT outsourcing, offshore, training and assimilation, and Ves as representatives for the world's leading software vendors. With vast experience in private and public sectors, ranging from Finance, Telecom, Health, Hi-Tech, Education, Defense, and Secu city, Matrix's customer base includes guest organizations in Israel and a steadily growing client base worldwide.

We are comprised of talented, creative, and dedicated individuals passionate about delivering innovative solutions to the market. We source and foster the best talent and recognize that all employee's contributions are integral to our company's future.

Matrix- success is based on a challenging work environment, competitive compensation and benefits, and rewarding career opportunities. We encourage a diverse work environment of sharing, learning, and ceding together. Come and join the winning team! You'll be challenged and have fun in a highly respected organization. title: HR Training Analyst
description:
Position: HR Training Analyst

Location: Barra da Tijuca, Rio de Janeiro


About Us

MISC Group is a world-leading provider of international energy-related maritime solutions and services.

For over 56 years, we have built a dynamic, progressive, and innovative global brand, delivering the highest standards of maritime services and creating sustainable value for our stakeholders worldwide.


Job Purpose

The HR Training & Personnel Logistics Analyst is responsible for ensuring full compliance of offshore personnel with mandatory training requirements, managing training logistics, and maintaining accurate certification records in DRAKE System.

The role also supports HR strategy implementation, training governance, personnel logistics coordination, and operational workforce readiness in alignment with corporate policies and project needs.


Key Responsibilities

Ensure that all offshore personnel hold valid mandatory training and certifications required for offshore deployment;

Coordinate all logistics arrangements for trainings scheduled in the DRAKE System;

Maintain strict control and timely updates of training and certification records in DRAKE;

Provide HR expertise in developing and implementing training-related policies, processes, and improvement actions according to business needs;

Interpret, apply, and uphold corporate policies and legal requirements with strong customer focus and best practices;

Apply an integrated approach when managing the employee mandatory training cycle (training matrix, gap analysis, deviation notices, certifications, training providers, and budget control) to effectively support Projects and Operations;

Monitor and support the local execution of HR Training policies, procedures, and processes;

Assist in managing the training budget, including creation and follow-up of Purchase Requisitions (PRs) for all training-related expenses;

Coordinate feedback from personnel regarding training provider performance and recommend improvements to management;

Support audits and evaluations of training service providers;

Provide operational support to the Personnel Logistics team, including weekend on-call coverage and emergency demands when required;

title: UI/UX Designer
description:
UI/UX Designer

Full-Time | Brazil (Hybrid) | Mid–Senior Level


About the Role

We build technology products for companies that are reshaping how industries operate. Our design team sits at the intersection of product strategy, engineering, and user research, and the work we do ships to real users.


This is not a purely visual design role. Designers here influence product direction, collaborate closely with engineers and product leaders, and help define how complex systems should actually work.


We are looking for a UI/UX Designer who can move fluidly between ambiguous discovery work and pixel-precise execution. You will partner with product managers, engineers, and client stakeholders to design experiences that are strategically sound and deeply usable.


What You'll Do

• Own design end-to-end for one or more product workstreams, from research and wireframes through final developer handoff

• Facilitate discovery sessions with clients and internal teams to clarify problems before jumping into solutions

• Produce high-fidelity prototypes and detailed design specifications that engineers can build from with minimal iteration

• Conduct usability testing and translate insights into actionable design improvements

• Contribute to and help maintain shared design systems across multiple products

• Present design rationale clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, including client leadership

• Collaborate with product managers to define success metrics for design decisions and evaluate outcomes after launch

What We're Looking For


Must-Have Experience

• 3+ years of product design experience, ideally within a startup, consultancy, or fast-paced product environment

• Strong portfolio demonstrating systems thinking and problem solving, not just visual design

• Advanced proficiency with Figma including components, auto-layout, variables, and interactive prototyping

• Experience designing for both web and mobile platforms with awareness of technical constraints

• Ability to communicate design decisions in terms of user impact and business value

• Comfortable working in ambiguous environments where problems are not fully defined


Nice to Have

• Experience designing products for enterprise or B2B users

• Familiarity with front-end development concepts such as HTML, CSS, or React fundamentals

• Experience with service design or end-to-end journey mapping for complex products

• Experience building or scaling a design system from the ground up


How We Work

Our teams operate in short delivery cycles with tight collaboration between design, product, and engineering. We prioritize fast decision making, direct communication, and high ownership.


We partner with organizations across industries including healthcare, financial services, logistics, and enterprise software. Projects range from building new products from scratch to modernizing complex legacy platforms.


What You'll Get

• Competitive base salary with performance-based compensation

• Comprehensive health, dental, and vision benefits

• Flexible remote-first environment with optional in-person collaboration

• Exposure to a wide range of industries and product challenges

• A design-focused team that values craft and pushes each other to produce exceptional work

title: Research Engineer, RL Environments
description:
About Turing

Turing builds large-scale datasets and reinforcement learning (RL) environments that power post-training for the world's leading AI labs and enterprises, including OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind, Microsoft AI, Amazon, Apple, and many more. We create RL environments to evaluate and improve our customers' models on complex, multi-step workflows across high-value domains — designing the tasks, reward signals, and verifiers that drive measurable model improvement through RL training.


The Role

We are looking for a Research Engineer, RL Environments to help design and build frontier-quality RL environments, reward systems, and evaluations that improve state-of-the-art models for leading AI labs and enterprise clients.

This is a hands-on, research-facing technical role. You will work directly with customer researchers and engineers to translate their post-training and RL goals into concrete environment specs — designing tasks with verifiable outcomes, building reward and verifier systems, and ensuring environments are robust against reward hacking and distribution collapse.


We're targeting candidates with roughly 4–5 years of experience building deep learning or RL systems — especially where strong results depended on environment design, reward engineering, training infrastructure, or rigorous evaluation.


What You'll Do:

1. Design and build RL environments and verifier systems

  • Work with customer researchers to translate RL training goals into environment specs: target capabilities, task distributions, difficulty curves, and success criteria.
  • Design task suites with verifiable outcomes — single-step and long-horizon workflows with clear ground-truth signals.
  • Build reward functions, verifiers, automatic validators, and evaluation harnesses that provide reliable training signal and resist gaming.
  • Define environment interfaces: APIs, tool schemas, state abstractions, database schemas, and simulator-like dynamics that give agents realistic constraints.


2. Build quality systems that keep environments robust at scale

  • Audit environments and trajectories for subtle failure modes: reward hacking, leakage, ambiguity, distribution shifts, and degenerate task distributions.
  • Implement automated validation: deduplication, decontamination, consistency checks, difficulty controls, and diversity monitoring.
  • Develop synthetic task generation and augmentation pipelines: programmatic generators, controlled perturbations, hard negatives, and scenario templating with diversity constraints.


3. Prove impact through evaluations and training runs

  • Design and run evals reflecting customer-intended model capabilities.
  • Produce analysis connecting environment design choices to training outcomes: pre/post comparisons, error breakdowns, and ablations identifying which environment and reward attributes drive model lift.
  • When needed, run RL or fine-tuning experiments (or partner with research) to validate that your environments produce measurable improvement.


4. Collaborate with cross-functional delivery teams

  • Provide clear specs, examples, and edge cases to engineers, domain SMEs, and data production groups.
  • Run fast feedback loops based on trajectory analysis and quantitative signals.
  • Review and improve outputs from large-scale task and environment creation efforts.


Who We're Looking For:

1. Required Qualifications

  • 4–5 years of experience building or improving deep learning or RL systems where environment design, data quality, or reward engineering mattered materially.
  • Hands-on experience with reinforcement learning — any of: environment/gym development, reward design, PPO/GRPO/DPO, trajectory collection, or RL training infrastructure.
  • Strong intuition for what makes a good training task: verifiability, appropriate difficulty, resistance to shortcuts, and realistic constraints.
  • Demonstrated ability to be extremely detail-oriented in diagnosing subtle quality issues and failure modes in data or environments.
  • Python proficiency required; comfort with SQL and structured data workflows strongly preferred.
  • Ability to communicate clearly with researchers and engineers — turning RL training objectives into concrete environment specs.


2. Highly valued experience

  • Post-training experience: RLHF/RLAIF, verifier training, reward modeling, or constitutional AI methods.
  • Experience building custom gym environments, simulators, or distributed RL training systems.
  • Agentic evaluation: tool use, multi-step workflows, long-horizon tasks, trajectory analysis.
  • Systems thinking: ability to simulate an application's API and data schema and design tasks reflecting real-world constraints.
  • Experience with LLM fine-tuning at scale.


Why Turing

  • Work directly with the world's leading AI labs on the RL environments powering post-training for frontier models.
  • Real impact: your environments and reward systems will directly shape how models learn to reason, act, and improve.
  • Talent-dense team with high autonomy, rapid iteration, and an exceptional learning curve.


Values:

  • We are client first : We put our clients at the center of everything we do, because their success is the ultimate measure of our value.
  • We work at Start-Up Speed: We move fast, stay agile and favor action because momentum is the foundation of perfection
  • We are Al forward: We help our clients build the future of Al and implement it in our own roles and workflow to amplify productivity.


Advantages of joining Turing:

  • Amazing work culture (Super collaborative & supportive work environment; 5 days a week)
  • Awesome colleagues (Surround yourself with top talent from Meta, Google, LinkedIn etc. as well as people with deep startup experience)
  • Competitive compensation
  • Flexible working hours


Don’t meet every single requirement?

Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. Turing is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristics. At Turing we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace and celebrate authenticity, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.


For applicants from the European Union, please review Turing's GDPR notice here.

title: Systems Engineer
description:

title: StarRocks Database Engineer (DBE) - Remote
description:
Database Engineer (DBE) – Enterprise Open-Source Support

Location : Remote (preferred South / Central America or US TIme Zones)

Department : Engineering - Open Source Database support

Reports to: CTO / VP Engineering


About Deep.BI

We provide enterprise support and consulting for open‑source analytics and data infrastructure platforms such as Apache Druid, Apache Flink, StarRocks and other emerging technologies.Our customers run mission‑critical, high‑volume systems and rely on us to keep them fast, stable, and available. We’re a small, world-class expert, remote‑first team working across multiple time zones (US, Brazil, Europe, India, Philippines), supporting 100+ customer environments with SLAs ranging from advisory support to 24/7 incident coverage.


Role Overview

As a Database Engineer (DBE), you will be the core L3/L4 technical expert responsible for solving the most complex database problems our customers face in production with an emphasis on supporting StarRocks clusters. You’ll dive deep into query optimization, ingestion pipelines, schema design, and HA/DR configuration — ensuring that large-scale analytical systems remain reliable, scalable, and performant.


While your primary focus is database internals and advanced troubleshooting, we value engineers with broader skills — knowledge of DevOps, Infrastructure, security or SRE Practices is highly appreciated and will make you even more impactful. 


Key Responsibilities

  • Advanced troubleshooting (L3/L4): Diagnose and resolve complex issues in StarRocks and other OLAP database clusters (performance Bottlenecks, ingestion failures, query regressions)
  • Performance optimization: Tune queries, schemas, ingestion flows, and configs to maximize efficiency under high load.
  • Architecture & design support: Work with Solution Architects to shape data models, indexing strategies, and HA/DR approaches.
  • Incident resolution under 24/7 SLA: Comfortable debugging under SLA pressure and participating in on-call rotations. Act as the escalation point for production incidents, ensuring rapid root cause analysis and fixes.
  • CVE patching: Apply, validate, and test security patches for database systems in customer environments.
  • Knowledge sharing: Document best practices, contribute to playbooks, and mentor junior engineers when needed.
  • Optional / nice-to-have:
  • Support deployments with DevOps engineers (Kubernetes, cloud, automation)
  • Assist in secure configuration and compliance requirements
  • Collaborate with developers (DD role) on upstream OSS bug fixes or feature contributions.


Requirements

  • 2+ years hands-on experience operating and troubleshooting StarRocks clusters in larger scale production (not just querying or dashboard usage; no PoCs) 
  • Proven experience with query optimization,indexing, schema design, and ingestion pipelines .
  • Solid knowledge of distributed systems concepts (consistency, replication, failover, scaling)
  • Hands-on experience with high availability and disaster recovery setups
  • Comfort with Linux systems, networking basics and SQL .
  • Ability to analyze logs, metrics, and configs under pressure (incident scenarios)
  • Strong English language communication skills — able to explain technical decisions clearly to engineers and delivery managers both verbally and in writing
  • Bonus: Experience with Apache Druid, ClickHouse, TiDB, Apache Cassandra, or similar databases
  • Bonus : Experience with Kubernetes, cloud infra (AWS/GCP/Azure), or security best practices (RBAC, encryption, IAM).
  • Bonus : Contributions to open-source database projects.


What we offer

  • Work with cutting-edge open-source technologies at enterprise scale .
  • Opportunity to collaborate with top engineers across databases, communities.
  • Competitive salary 
  • Support for conference travel and OSS contributions
  • Flexible contract structure (direct employment or via a global payroll partner or contractor/B2B), depending on your location and preference.


Location & working style

  • Remote‑first - we collaborate online across multiple time zones.
  • Role requires regular overlap with European and North American business hours.

title: Junior Sales Closer (Consultor de Vendas)
description:
Localização:  Barra da Tijuca, RJ


Tipo de vaga:  PJ (Pessoa Jurídica), tempo integral, R$ 6.000,00 fixo + comissões ilimitadas  


Sobre a Ótima Energia

Não somos apenas mais uma corretora de energia empurrando uma única solução. Na Ótima Energia, existimos para trazer clareza e confiança a um mercado confuso. As empresas brasileiras pagam caro pela energia não porque faltam opções, mas porque o mercado é barulhento: ofertas confusas, contratos ambíguos e vendedores empurrando o que paga a melhor comissão para eles.


Nós substituímos isso por uma abordagem neutra e baseada em dados. Nosso sistema de IA, o ECOS™, analisa os três mercados de energia (ACR, ACL, GDL) e diz às empresas exatamente onde elas economizarão mais, com zero conflito de interesses.


Nossa promessa: Sua energia. Sua escolha. Sua economia.  Estamos crescendo rápido. E precisamos de pessoas que amam vencer.


A Função: Closer (Consultor de Energia)

Este não é um trabalho para quem precisa que as coisas sejam fáceis. Este é um lugar para quem:

  • É um talento de alto potencial finalmente pronto para ser liberado.
  • Tem habilidade comprovada e busca o palco à altura da sua ambição.
  • Sabe o que é ralar e quer ralar por algo real.
  • Faz as pessoas se sentirem bem apenas por estarem no mesmo ambiente.
  • É um doador de energia, não um sugador.


Este Trabalho NÃO É Para Você Se:

  • Você trata a empatia como uma tática em vez de um traço de personalidade.
  • Você fala muito, mas tem zero disciplina para sustentar o que diz.
  • Você é uma \"pessoa de pessoas\", mas desmorona ao ser rejeitado.
  • Você ama o holofote, mas odeia a disciplina necessária para se manter nele.
  • Você está esperando por um \"golpe de sorte\" em vez de trabalhar mais que todos na sala.
  • Você tem \"100% de potencial\", mas só entrega 50% de esforço quando ninguém está olhando.


Quem Você É


Qualidade Por que isso importa


Você ama vencer | Fechar negócios traz uma sensação imbatível. Você é competitivo e acompanha seu placar.


Você é mentalmente forte | A rejeição não te abala. Você sabe que o \"não\" é apenas um número no caminho para o \"sim\".


Você é implacável | Você faz 60 ligações. Depois 80. Depois 100. Você não para até o trabalho estar feito.


Um charme natural | As pessoas genuinamente gostam de falar com você. Você cria conexão em segundos.


Esforço gera recompensa | Você entende que, aqui, resultados = recompensas financeiras.


Treinável, não robótico | Você domina o processo e o script, e depois os torna seus.


Disseram que você não seria capaz | E você ainda está aqui. Pronto para provar que estavam errados.


Fala Inglês | Básico ao avançado — o suficiente para entender documentos e falar com nosso fundador.


O Que Você Fará

  • Fazer de 60 a 100 ligações por dia para leads qualificados.
  • Ter conversas reais sobre economia de energia.
  • Explicar nossa abordagem neutra e sem conflito de interesses.
  • Lidar com objeções. Superar o \"não tenho interesse\". Transformar \"talvez\" em \"sim\".
  • Fechar negócios. E depois fechar mais.
  • Este é um jogo de volume. Os melhores closers fazem o maior número de ligações. É matemática pura.


O Dinheiro (É Bom)


Métrica | O que significa


Base Fixa | R$ 6.000,00 mensais.  Estabilidade garantida enquanto você constrói.


Comissão por negócio | Generosa. Sem teto. Receba pelo seu desempenho.


OTE (Ganho Estimado) | Profissionais de alto desempenho superam R$ 12.000,00+  por mês.


Sem Limites | Não travamos sua comissão. Quanto mais você vende, mais você ganha.


O Pacote

  • Contrato PJ: Você trabalha como pessoa jurídica. Simples, direto e profissional.
  • Equipamento: Fornecemos laptop + toda a tecnologia necessária. Sem custo para você.
  • Ferramentas: Zoho, Portal, sistema de leads — tudo configurado e pronto.
  • Treinamento: Completo sobre o mercado de energia, nosso processo e ferramentas.
  • Suporte: Você nunca será deixado sozinho para \"dar um jeito\".


Por Que Se Juntar a Nós

  • Ganhos ilimitados: Sua renda é limitada apenas pelo seu esforço e habilidade.
  • Oportunidade massiva: Milhares de leads qualificados esperando para serem chamados.
  • Produto real: Nós realmente ajudamos donos de empresas a economizar dinheiro.
  • Sem microgerenciamento: Confiamos no seu trabalho duro. Seus resultados falam por si.
  • Potencial de crescimento: Quem performa vira líder de equipe, gerente e depois diretor.
  • Um lugar para os subestimados: Se já duvidaram de você antes, você vai se sentir em casa aqui.
  • Uso do Inglês: Sua habilidade no idioma é um trunfo real aqui.


Choque de Realidade

Este trabalho não é para todos. Você ouvirá \"não\" muito mais do que ouvirá \"sim\". Você fará ligações mesmo quando não estiver com vontade. Você passará por cima da rejeição e continuará em frente.

Mas, se você vencer, você vence grande.  Os melhores closers aqui ganharão mais do que muitos gerentes. Eles terão liberdade, respeito e um plano de carreira.


﻿

Como Se Candidatar

Não queremos currículos. Queremos ver você. Grave um vídeo de 30 segundos respondendo:

  • Quem é você? 2. Por que você? Pode ser em português. Apenas seja você mesmo. 30 segundos. Sem roteiro. Sem edições. Apenas você.
  • Envie para: ⚠️ IMPORTANTE: Candidaturas sem vídeo NÃO serão consideradas. Este trabalho é sobre falar com pessoas. Se você não consegue falar conosco por 30 segundos, não conseguirá falar com 100 clientes por dia. Vídeo ou nada.

Uma Última Coisa:  Não precisamos de especialistas em energia. Precisamos de pessoas disciplinadas, apaixonadas e que se importam com tudo o que fazem. O resto, nós ensinamos.

Ótima Energia  Construída por pessoas que não deveriam estar aqui.

title: Accountant (with Advanced English)
description:
About the Product


Niche is the leader in school search. Our mission is to make researching and enrolling in schools easy, transparent, and free. With in-depth profiles on every school and college in America, 140 million reviews and ratings, and powerful search tools, we help millions of people find the right school for them. We also help thousands of schools recruit more best-fit students, by highlighting what makes them great and making it easier to visit and apply.

Niche is all about finding where you belong, and that mission inspires how we operate every day. We want Niche to be a place where people truly enjoy working and can thrive professionally.


About the Role


The Associate Staff Accountant is a key operational member of the Finance team, responsible for owning day-to-day billing and accounts receivable activities while also serving as a backup and support resource across accounts payable, procurement, and general ledger operations.

This role sits at the intersection of accounting operations, customer communication, and financial systems. The Associate Staff Accountant ensures timely and accurate invoicing, collections, and customer support, while also contributing to month-end close, reconciliations, and process automation initiatives. You will work closely with the Associate Accounting Manager, Controller, and internal account managers to maintain accurate financial records and support scalable finance operations.


What You Will Do


Primary Responsibilities: Billing & Accounts Receivable

  • Customer Billing Ownership: Prepare, review, and issue accurate customer invoices in accordance with contracts, pricing schedules, and billing timelines.
  • Collections Management: Monitor accounts receivable aging, proactively follow up on overdue invoices, and manage customer communications to drive timely payment.
  • Cash Application: Apply customer payments accurately and promptly; research and resolve unapplied cash, short payments, and discrepancies.
  • Billing Disputes & Resolution: Partner with customers and internal account managers to investigate and resolve billing questions, disputes, and adjustments.
  • Customer Support: Serve as a primary finance contact for billing and payment inquiries, delivering clear, professional, and timely responses.


Reporting, Analysis & Cross-Functional Support

  • AR & Billing Reporting: Prepare AR aging reports, collections summaries, billing metrics, and customer-level analysis for Finance leadership.
  • Trend & Issue Identification: Identify recurring billing or collections issues and recommend process improvements.
  • Internal Collaboration: Support Customer Success and Account Management teams with invoice status, payment history, and customer financial insights.
  • Ad-Hoc Analysis: Assist with financial analysis and special projects related to revenue, AR, or operational accounting.


Secondary Responsibilities: AP, Procurement & GL (Backup Coverage)

  • Accounts Payable Support: Serve as backup for the full-cycle AP process, including invoice review, coding, approvals, and payment execution using tools such as Ramp.
  • Procurement & Spend Compliance: Ensure spend is appropriately authorized, documented, and coded to the correct GL accounts, departments, and locations.
  • Expense Management: Support travel and expense processing, including receipt matching and policy enforcement.
  • Vendor Relations (Backup): Assist with vendor inquiries and resolution of payment or billing issues as needed.


General Ledger & Month-End Close Support

  • Journal Entries: Prepare and post routine journal entries, accruals, and adjustments under supervision to support accurate financial reporting.
  • Reconciliations: Perform monthly reconciliations of bank and balance sheet accounts, investigating and resolving variances.
  • Audit & Documentation: Maintain organized support schedules and documentation for management review and external audits.
  • System Integrity: Monitor accounting system data flows to ensure automated postings align with accounting principles and internal controls.
  • Process Automation: Support ongoing efforts to improve efficiency and reduce manual work using modern accounting and fintech tools (e.g., Rillet, Ramp).


What We Are Looking For

  • Accounting Foundation: Solid understanding of basic accounting principles; familiarity with GAAP preferred.
  • AR & Billing Experience: Prior experience in billing, accounts receivable, collections, or customer-facing finance roles.
  • Customer Communication Skills: Strong written and verbal English skills with the ability to communicate professionally with external customers.
  • Technical Proficiency: Experience with modern accounting, billing, or expense management systems (e.g., Rillet, Ramp, NetSuite, QuickBooks, Zuora, Stripe, or similar).
  • Excel Skills: Proficient in Excel, including formulas, lookups, and pivot tables.
  • Detail-Oriented & Organized: High attention to accuracy, deadlines, and follow-through in a process-driven environment.
  • Adaptability: Comfortable supporting multiple accounting functions and serving as backup when priorities shift.
  • Experience Level: 4+ years of relevant accounting, billing, or AR experience; experience supporting US-based companies is a plus.


We offer

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Fully remote.


Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

Garantir a operação estável, segura e eficiente das redes de comunicação de dados e voz do IRB(Re), assegurando disponibilidade, desempenho e confiabilidade dos serviços de conectividade corporativa. É o responsável técnico pela infraestrutura de rede, abrangendo LAN, WAN, Wi-Fi, VPN, firewalls e equipamentos de comunicação, suportando as operações do negócio e garantindo conformidade com as políticas de segurança e governança de TI.

Assegurar a continuidade e a resiliência das redes corporativas, promovendo padronização, automação e melhoria contínua da infraestrutura de conectividade que sustenta os sistemas críticos e o ambiente híbrido do IRB(Re).


PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES


Gestão e Operação de Ambientes

  • Administrar e monitorar a rede corporativa LAN/WAN/Wi-Fi, em ambientes on-premises e cloud, garantindo disponibilidade, estabilidade e desempenho;
  • Configurar, manter e otimizar switches, roteadores, access points, firewalls, balanceadores e VPNs;
  • Monitorar a latência, throughput e integridade dos enlaces de rede, propondo ações corretivas e preventivas;
  • Executar rotinas de backup e restauração de configurações de rede;
  • Gerenciar e documentar o inventário de equipamentos de rede, seus contratos de manutenção;
  • Apoiar times de Service Desk e Infraestrutura na resolução de incidentes relacionados à conectividade;
  • Garantir o cumprimento de SLAs de disponibilidade e performance de rede, com reportes regulares à Governança de TI.


Implementação e Melhoria Contínua

  • Planejar e executar projetos de implantação, atualização e expansão de rede, em alinhamento com Engenharia & Plataforma;
  • Definição de escopo técnico para projetos de infraestrutura de redes, visando escalabilidade e alta disponibilidade dos serviços, garantindo o alinhamento entre requisitos técnicos e necessidades de negócio;
  • Avaliar novas tecnologias e padrões de conectividade (SD-WAN, Wi-Fi 6, 5G, Zero Trust Network Access);
  • Automatizar tarefas de configuração e monitoração com uso de ferramentas de gerenciamento de rede e scripts (Ansible, Python, SNMP, etc.);
  • Apoiar a integração de ambientes on-premises e cloud (Azure, AWS, GCP) garantindo conectividade segura;
  • Participar da definição de arquiteturas de rede resilientes e escaláveis, em conjunto com Arquitetura Corporativa;
  • Documentar diagramas, topologias e fluxos de rede no repositório corporativo de arquitetura;
  • Realizar testes de carga, failover e redundância em enlaces críticos.


Segurança, Governança e Compliance

  • Operar e gerenciar ferramentas de segurança, como: Endpoint Security, NGFW, PAM, WAF, Cloud Email Security, NAC, DNS Security, de acordo as diretrizes do CISO;
  • Monitorar e responder a alertas de segurança de rede, incidentes e vulnerabilidades, em colaboração com o time de Cyber Service;
  • Apoiar auditorias internas e externas, fornecendo evidências de controles e conformidade (LGPD, SUSEP, SOX);
  • Assegurar a execução de atualizações de firmware e patches de segurança nos dispositivos de rede;
  • Gerenciar logs e trilhas de auditoria de equipamentos e soluções de rede;
  • Apoiar o planejamento e execução de planos de continuidade e recuperação de desastres (DRP) para infraestrutura de rede.



BENEFÍCIOS


  • Assistência médica
  • Assistência odontológica
  • Auxílio creche
  • Participação nos Lucros ou Resultados
  • Previdência privada
  • Seguro de vida
  • Vale alimentação e/ou Vale-refeição
  • Wellhub (antigo Gympass)

  • Optimization: Continuously sharpen pacing, copy overlays, hooks, captions, structure, sound design, and visual clarity.
  • Trend Awareness: Stay current on paid social trends, platform best practices, and emerging editing and AI tools.


WHAT YOU BRING

Skills that ship.

  • Editing Tools: Expert in Adobe Premiere Pro, Capcut, Davinci Resolve. Solid working knowledge of After Effects and Photoshop.
  • Motion Design: Strong command of animation, typography, transitions, sound design, pacing, color, and visual storytelling.
  • Performance Mindset: You understand what makes a direct-response ad work—hooks, clarity, messaging hierarchy, pacing, and CTA structure.
  • AI Fluency: Comfortable using AI tools daily as part of your production stack, not as a novelty.
  • Output Velocity: Able to manage multiple edits simultaneously, hit deadlines, and sustain high-quality output at scale.
  • Captions & Copy: Writes and applies accurate, compelling English captions that reinforce messaging and hooks.

  • Industry: Experience with DTC, healthcare, wellness, or weight-loss brands.

NICE TO HAVE

Bonus points.

title: Brand & Copy Strategist

You ensure that every piece of written content across websites, social media, email, and campaigns is on-brand, intentional, and delivered at a high standard. You act as the bridge between brand intent and execution, translating client goals and direction into clear, purposeful copy that is ready for internal review and client delivery.

2. Strategy & Project Management

  • -Consistency in writing style

  • Develop and write social media copy that reflects the brand’s voice and messaging.

1. Brand Alignment & Copy Effectiveness

The role is to build strong strategic business relationships that lead to the sourcing of current and future M&A opportunities for Perseus. Relationships will be formed with decision makers (i.e. CEOs/VPs of Corporate Development/founders/owners) of software companies globally, M&A advisors, and private equity/venture capital professionals. Success is defined by building and maintaining meaningful relationships, having clients sign LOI’s and ultimately, the acquisition of software companies/assets by Perseus/Constellation.

Initiating relationships, maintaining relationships, and ultimately being considered and chosen to be acquired by Perseus/Constellation typically takes multiple years. Measurable outcomes, continuous value-add through many M&A conversations/relationships and high-quality market research is what ultimately generates successful acquisitions through time.

  • Meet and exceed monthly M&A targets, such as meaningful contacts and other measurable M&A sourcing KPIs.

  • Ensure the lead database is allocated accurately within portfolio verticals

Relevant Experience & Competencies:

  • Experience in a Business Development/Sales position at a software company or client-facing M&A/finance role within business development, sales, and/or account management. Preference for experience in outbound-focused origination roles.

  • Previous high-performance in Business Development, winning in an autonomous role or, prior success in other walks of life outside professional BD experience, such as entrepreneurship, will be considered.

title: Artificial Intelligence Specialist
description:
Especialista Sênior em Agentes de Inteligência Artificial

Data de início: imediata

Tempo de alocação: indeterminado

Horário: 9h00 às 18h00

Idiomas: inglês intermediário


Visão Geral da Posição


Buscamos um(a) Especialista Sênior em Agentes de Inteligência Artificial com perfil altamente técnico e atuação hands-on, capaz de projetar, desenvolver e evoluir agentes autônomos baseados em LLMs. Este(a) profissional será responsável não apenas por interfaces conversacionais, mas principalmente pela construção da lógica de decisão, orquestração de ferramentas, memória, contexto e integração com sistemas corporativos.


A posição exige forte domínio em engenharia de software aplicada à IA, arquitetura de soluções com GenAI e implementação de agentes robustos para ambientes produtivos, com foco em confiabilidade, escalabilidade e geração de valor para o negócio.


Responsabilidades


• Projetar e implementar agentes de IA com lógica de decisão estruturada, uso de ferramentas, memória e controle de fluxo

• Desenvolver arquiteturas baseadas em RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) para respostas fundamentadas em dados internos

• Integrar LLMs a sistemas corporativos via APIs, bancos de dados, serviços internos e plataformas externas

• Definir estratégias de prompt engineering, avaliação e melhoria contínua de desempenho dos agentes

• Estruturar pipelines de dados para indexação, embeddings e busca vetorial

• Atuar na definição de padrões de arquitetura, qualidade de código e boas práticas de engenharia para soluções de IA

• Trabalhar em conjunto com times de produto, dados e engenharia para transformar necessidades de negócio em soluções baseadas em agentes

• Apoiar tecnicamente desenvolvedores de níveis pleno e júnior, promovendo evolução técnica do time


Requisitos Obrigatórios


• Perfil sênior hands-on, com capacidade de implementar a lógica interna de agentes além da camada conversacional

• Domínio avançado em Python (preferencial para IA) ou Node.js/TypeScript

• Experiência prática com frameworks de orquestração de agentes como LangChain, LlamaIndex, Agno/PhiData ou CrewAI

• Experiência com bancos de dados vetoriais para busca semântica

• Domínio avançado de técnicas de RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation)

• Experiência com integração e ajuste de prompts para LLMs como GPT-4, Claude 3.5 Sonnet, além de modelos open-source como Llama 3 e Mistral

• Experiência com serviços de IA em nuvem como AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI Service ou Google Vertex AI

• Sólidos conhecimentos em APIs RESTful, arquitetura de microserviços e conteinerização com Docker


Requisitos Desejáveis


• Experiência em LLMOps, incluindo monitoramento, rastreabilidade e avaliação de modelos em produção com ferramentas como LangSmith, Arize Phoenix ou Ragas

• Conhecimento em criação de agentes com estado e ciclos utilizando LangGraph

• Experiência prática com fine-tuning de modelos para domínios específicos

• Conhecimento em bancos de dados orientados a grafos como Neo4j para estratégias de GraphRAG

• Experiência com execução de modelos locais utilizando Ollama ou vLLM


Competências Comportamentais e Soft Skills


• Capacidade de traduzir problemas complexos de negócio em arquiteturas de agentes de IA claras e estruturadas

• Pensamento sistêmico para conectar dados, modelos, ferramentas e fluxos de decisão

• Comunicação técnica clara com áreas não técnicas, facilitando alinhamento entre tecnologia e negócio

• Postura colaborativa para atuação em times multidisciplinares

• Proatividade na identificação de melhorias técnicas e oportunidades de uso de IA

• Capacidade de mentoria e referência técnica para profissionais menos experientes

• Organização e disciplina para trabalhar com experimentação contínua sem perder rastreabilidade e governança

• Senso crítico para avaliar riscos, limitações de modelos e impactos éticos das soluções de IA


Diferenciais de Perfil


• Experiência prévia em ambientes de alta escala ou sistemas críticos

• Vivência em times de inovação, P&D ou construção de plataformas de IA do zero

• Forte preocupação com qualidade, observabilidade e confiabilidade de agentes em produção


Maiores detalhes técnicos, de contexto do produto e expectativas do cliente serão apresentados durante a entrevista técnica.

title: Head of Analytics & Business Intelligence

The ideal candidate is someone who not only builds dashboards but actively tracks performance, identifies trends, and provides clear conclusions and recommendations that help the company make better decisions.

You will work closely with leadership, marketing, product, sales, and customer success to ensure the company operates in a data-driven way .

  • Design, build, and maintain dashboards and reports that track key company metrics.
  • Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and reliability across all systems.

Continuously track and analyze key business metrics including:

Revenue & Financial Metrics

  • MRR / ARR
  • Revenue growth
  • Churn
  • Net Revenue Retention (NRR)
  • Expansion revenue

Marketing Performance

  • Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC)
  • Channel performance
  • Attribution analysis
  • Funnel conversion rates
  • Campaign performance

Product Analytics

  • User activation
  • Feature adoption
  • Product usage trends
  • Customer retention and engagement

Sales Analytics

  • Pipeline performance
  • Conversion rates
  • Sales cycle length
  • Revenue forecasting

Requirements:

  • 5+ years of experience in analytics, business intelligence, or data analysis .
  • Experience working in SaaS or technology companies .
  • Strong understanding of SaaS metrics and revenue models .
  • Proven ability to translate data into clear insights and strategic recommendations.
  • Experience building dashboards and analytics systems.


Skills:

  • BI and analytics platforms (Looker, Tableau, Metabase, Power BI, etc.)
  • SQL and data querying
  • Data visualization and dashboard creation
  • CRM analytics (HubSpot, Salesforce, or similar)
  • Marketing analytics platforms
  • Product analytics tools (Mixpanel, Amplitude, or similar)


Key Qualities

  • Highly analytical and detail-oriented
  • Strong problem-solving skills
  • Ability to turn complex data into clear, actionable insights
  • Strong communication skills
  • Proactive mindset and ownership of results


What Success Looks Like in This Role

  • Leadership has clear visibility into company performance at all times .
  • Key dashboards track the company’s most important metrics.
  • Data insights lead to better strategic decisions and faster growth .
  • The organization becomes increasingly data-driven in how it operates .

We're not pre-revenue. We're not burning cash. We're growing, and we need a senior full-stack mobile engineer who can ship production React Native features on day one.


What you'll build: You'll lead development across our React Native mobile app (Expo, TypeScript, TanStack Query, Zustand) and work with our existing Node.js/TypeScript backend. This isn't maintenance. You're shipping features that users interact with immediately.


Day to day, you'll be working on things like:

  • Designing and building new features end-to-end in React Native with TypeScript

You should have:

  • 5+ years shipping production React Native apps (not React web — we will verify this)

  • Backend capability with Node.js — you can work with and extend our existing API layer
  • Hands-on experience integrating third-party APIs, especially payment processors
  • Comfort working independently in a small team where you own the outcome


Nice to have:

  • Experience with travel tech, hospitality, or marketplace platforms
  • Familiarity with booking/reservation systems

  • Apple Pay integration experience


Why FlyMeOut:

  • Profitable company with real revenue — not a cash-burning startup hoping for a runway extension
  • Growing 160%+ year-over-year with a planned fundraise in summer 2026
  • Fully remote — we hire across Latin America and work on overlapping timezones
  • Lean team, big ownership — your input directly shapes the product
  • Expanding into yacht charters, villa rentals, and restaurant reservations — you'd be building these from the ground up
  • Work directly with the founder on product and technical direction


Compensation & Terms

This is a full-time remote contractor position paid as a flat monthly rate via Wise.

Send your resume to with the subject line FMO-RN-2026 . In the body of your email, name one React Native app you have shipped that is currently live on the App Store or Google Play. Applications without this subject line will not be reviewed.

Hourly Rate: $60.00

Minimum Hours: No minimum

About Prolific

Prolific is not just another player in the AI space. We are building the biggest pool of quality human data in the world.

Over 35,000 AI developers, researchers, and organisations use Prolific to gather data from paid study participants with a wide variety of experiences, knowledge, and skills.


The Opportunity

We are inviting Certified Accountants to join our global network of Subject Matter Experts (SMEs). This is not a traditional accounting role; instead, you will be providing expert-level analysis for B2B and AI Research projects that require a deep understanding of fiscal regulations, reporting standards, and financial logic.

Please note: This is a \"bench\" model. By verifying your credentials, you gain eligibility for high-level research tasks as they become available. Access is based on project demand and professional profile matching.


What you’ll be doing

When selected for an active project, your tasks will involve:

  • Professional document analysis: Reviewing complex financial statements, audit reports, and regulatory filings to ensure data integrity.
  • Domain-specific validation: Answering knowledge-based questions that require an active understanding of international or local accounting standards.
  • Business logic synthesis: Providing the professional \"human-in-the-loop\" oversight that ensures B2B research is accurate and enterprise-ready.


What you’ll bring

  • Active certification: You must hold a valid, verifiable professional license (e.g., CPA, ACCA, ACA, CIMA, or regional equivalent).
  • Technical rigor: The ability to navigate long-form financial documents and extract precise information under research conditions.
  • Global perspective: We welcome qualified accountants from around the world who can apply their local or international standards to complex datasets.
  • Integrity: All participants must undergo a verification process to confirm their active professional standing.


Why join this project?

This is a flexible, high-rate opportunity to apply your specialised certification to the forefront of global business research. At $60 per hour , you can contribute your expertise on an ad hoc basis that fits perfectly around your existing clients or firm commitments.


Why Prolific is a great platform to join as an expert participant

Joining our platform as a participant will give you the chance to influence the AI models of the future. Once you pass our assessment, you can join Prolific in just 15 minutes and start enjoying competitive pay rates, flexible hours, and the ability to work from home.


We've built a unique platform that connects researchers and companies with a global pool of participants, enabling the collection of high-quality, ethically sourced human behavioral data and feedback. This data is the cornerstone of developing more accurate, nuanced, and aligned AI systems.


We believe that the next leap in AI capabilities won't come solely from scaling existing models, but from integrating diverse human perspectives and behaviors into AI development. By providing this crucial human data infrastructure, Prolific is positioning itself at the forefront of the next wave of AI innovation – one that reflects the breadth and the best of humanity.

Website

Youtube


Privacy Statement

By submitting your application, you agree that Prolific may collect your personal data for recruiting and global organization planning. Prolific's Candidate Privacy Notice explains what personal information Prolific may process, where Prolific may process your personal information, its purposes for processing your personal information, and the rights you can exercise over Prolific's use of your personal information.

title: Auxiliar de loja
description:
A CK é uma marca norte-americana fundada em 1968 na cidade de Nova York, e que manteve sua iconicidade e atemporalidade até os dias atuais. Este nome se expandiu ao redor do mundo, e por isso hoje está presente em vários países, inclusive no Brasil.

Nacionalmente contamos com +2.000 pontos de venda, além de termos nossa matriz corporativa presente na cidade de São Paulo, e contarmos com 2 centros de distribuição: um em Cotia/SP, e outro em Serra/ES.

Nosso propósito é “impulsionar a moda para o bem”, além de termos como visão “sermos a marca de fashion lifestyle mais admirada do mundo!”. Para isso, temos alguns valores como individualidade, integridade, paixão, parceria e responsabilidade.

Além disso, a CK é conhecida por seu grande compromisso com Diversidade e Inclusão! Todas as nossas vagas são direcionadas a todos os públicos, valorizando a pluralidade de identidades e experiências. Por isso, incentivamos a candidatura de pessoas negras, LGBTQIAPN+, pessoas com deficiência, indígenas, de diferentes gerações, e outros tipos de diversidade. Aqui, você é uma pessoa bem-vinda para ser quem é (lembra do nosso valor de #individualidade? =D)!

Como será seu dia a dia aqui:


Reportando-se ao Gerente de Loja, sua principal responsabilidade será prestar suporte geral a loja, com atendimento em caixa, apoio aos vendedores, controles administrativos, organização de estoque, possibilitando uma boa experiência do cliente em visita e consumo da loja, além do controle e organização seguindo os procedimentos e as políticas internas da CK.

Além disso você também será responsável por:

  • Processar as vendas de produtos no momento da compra do cliente, ofertando produtos adicionais para a venda agregada no caixa;
  • Dar suporte aos vendedores durante o atendimento aos clientes, acompanhando necessidades de busca de produtos, verificando se o cliente precisa de algum apoio, oferecendo conforto e acolhimento com café, água, guarda de volumes e demais condições disponíveis pela loja.
  • Manter os produtos da loja alarmados, repostos, precificados, controlados e passados, verificando as necessidades de arrumação de estoque, araras, gavetas, frente de loja e demais locais de exposição ou armazenamento de produtos, efetuando ou acompanhando contagens de inventário, movimentando os itens quando necessário e respeitando os padrões e orientações tanto de Visual Merchandising quanto da liderança imediata.

Seniority: 3+ years in B2B SaaS Customer Support

We’re hiring a Customer Support Specialist with strong technical capabilities to help us deliver high-quality, reliable support at scale.


At FullEnrich, support is central to the product experience. Our customers rely on our data for revenue-generating workflows. That means our responses must be accurate, structured, and genuinely helpful, not just fast.


About FullEnrich

FullEnrich helps businesses find accurate emails and phone numbers to reach the right people.


Unlike most enrichment tools that rely on a single source, FullEnrich aggregates 20+ data providers into a waterfall system that automatically tests multiple sources to return the best available contact data.


We are a profitable B2B data platform used by 3,000+ customers, with around 2,000 new signups every week. Our product supports sales, recruiting, marketing, and operations teams worldwide.


We’re a remote-first team of 20+ people across the US, UK, and Europe. We value ownership, clarity, and high standards in how we work.


What You’ll Do

  • Respond to customer questions via Intercom (chat & email) and Slack
  • Troubleshoot product, billing, and account-related issues
  • Help customers troubleshoot API requests, bulk CSV uploads, credit usage questions, and external tool integrations (e.g. HubSpot, Salesforce, Zapier)
  • Investigate issues using internal documentation and tools before escalating
  • Manage multiple real-time conversations while maintaining clarity and quality
  • Escalate bugs with clear context and reproducible steps
  • Improve internal documentation when gaps are identified


We value thoughtful problem-solving. Clear explanations matter as much as technical accuracy.


What We’re Looking For

  • 3+ years of experience in B2B SaaS customer support
  • Strong understanding of APIs, external tool integrations, and bulk data uploads (CSV)
  • Comfortable troubleshooting technical issues independently
  • Excellent written English
  • French familiarity required; fluency not necessary
  • Experience with Intercom or similar support tools
  • Structured, calm, and reliable in real-time chat environments
  • Based in LATAM time zones


Why Work at FullEnrich

  • Profitable and growing with strong product-market fit
  • A small team where your work has visible impact
  • Remote-first and internationally distributed
  • A support culture focused on quality, clarity, and accountability


If you take pride in delivering exceptional support and enjoy solving technical problems thoroughly, we’d be happy to hear from you.

title: SAP Basis Pleno com espanhol avançado
description:
Buscamos um(a) SAP Basis Pleno  com espanhol avançado  para atuar em Managed Services  e projetos  (assessment de performance, migração e otimização). O(a) profissional atuará em ambientes RISE/SAP S/4HANA  e on‑prem/híbridos , com forte interface com Infra de Banco de Dados (HANA, Sybase, Oracle)  e Cloud (GCP, Azure, AWS) .


Responsabilidades principais:

  • Sustentação (L2/L3)  de landscapes SAP (S/4HANA, ECC, BTP/integrações, Fiori), incluindo monitoramento , incident management , problem management  e changes  (janelas programadas).
  • Operação de DB/Infra : administração e troubleshooting de SAP HANA , SAP ASE/Sybase  e Oracle  (backup/restore, tunning, roles/segurança, housekeeping, BR*Tools, etc.).
  • Cloud  (GCP/Azure/AWS): suporte a arquiteturas SAP em nuvem (compute/storage/network), conexões seguras , sizing, troubleshooting de conectividade e serviços gerenciados.
  • Projetos técnicos :
  • Performance assessment  (end‑to‑end: app/server/DB), análise de traces, memória, I/O, jobs, RFCs.
  • Migrações/Upgrades  (blue/green/rolling), patching  de kernel/DB/OS, SAP Notes  e manutenções de rotina.
  • Otimizações : melhoria contínua (ajustes de parâmetros, automações, scripts, alertas).
  • Governança e documentação : execução de checklists , RCA  (5 porquês / Ishikawa), Hiper‑care pós‑mudança , documentação reutilizável e handover.
  • Colaboração cross : interação com PMO/SDM, times de segurança, redes, vendors/hyperscalers e SAP Support (OSS).


Requisitos obrigatórios:

  • Espanhol avançado  (reuniões e escrita). Português : avançado. Inglês : leitura técnica.
  • Experiência comprovada  em SAP Basis  em Managed Services  (operando múltiplos clientes/landscapes).
  • DB/Infra : HANA  (Studio/Cockpit, backup/restore, performance, roles), Sybase/ASE  e Oracle  (BR*Tools, RMAN, parâmetros, troubleshooting).
  • Cloud : experiências práticas com GCP  e/ou Azure  e/ou AWS  para workloads SAP (compute, storage, networking, IAM/segurança básica, conectividade híbrida).
  • Projetos : participação ativa em assessments de performance , migrações  (incl. OS/DB/KERNEL), upgrades  e patching .
  • Conhecimento de RISE with SAP  e ecossistema atual (S/4HANA, BTP, integração com hyperscalers).
  • Vivência com monitoramento  (ST03N/ST02/SM21/DBA Cockpit, etc.), transportes  (STMS), jobs  (SM37), spool  (SP01), locks  (SM12/DB), RFC  (SM59), notas SAP  (SNOTE).
  • Boas práticas de ITSM/ITIL , segurança  (perfis/autorização básicos), documentação  e runbooks .


Diferenciais:

  • Certificações : SAP Certified Technology Associate (S/4HANA, HANA), OS/DB Migration , especializações em hyperscalers  (Azure/AWS/GCP) e segurança .
  • Experiência com SAP Web Dispatcher , SAP Router , Solution Manager/ALM , Fiori , BTP  (connectivity, destinations), Cloud Connector .
  • Automação (scripts, pipelines, Infra as Code), observability (Dynatrace, Splunk, Grafana/Prometheus) e cost/performance optimization  em cloud.
  • Atuação prévia em War Rooms  e crise  (P1), com comunicação executiva.

title: Engenheiro de Software Sênior | Flutter | PJ
description:

Tudo isso em uma cultura de alta performance, forte, colaborativa e conectada ao nosso propósito. Parceria com Produto e Liderança

  • Antecipar complexidades técnicas
  • Estimar esforços com precisão
  • Sugerir alternativas técnicas para acelerar o time-to-market


Integração Sistêmica (Backend)

  • Liderar, junto ao time de Backend, a definição de contratos de API e arquitetura de dados
  • Garantir performance, segurança e economia de recursos no mobile


3. Governança e Sustentação

Gestão de Incidentes (L3)

  • Atuar na resolução de bugs críticos e problemas complexos em produção
  • Realizar análise de causa raiz
  • Propor melhorias estruturais para evitar recorrências


Estratégia de Homologação

  • Estabelecer padrões de testes automatizados (unitários, widget e integração)
  • Definir fluxos de homologação
  • Garantir consistência entre Android e iOS com mínima intervenção manual


4. Excelência em Performance e UI/UX

Experiência e Layout

  • Garantir fidelidade visual ao Figma
  • Atuar junto ao time de Design para discutir usabilidade e viabilidade técnica


Otimização de Alto Nível

  • Monitorar métricas de performance (memória, jank e tempo de inicialização)

Roadmap Técnico

  • Manter atualização sobre o ecossistema Flutter/Dart
  • Avaliar e decidir adoção de novas bibliotecas ou ferramentas com ganho real de produtividade


Mitigação de Riscos e Débito Técnico

  • Identificar débitos técnicos e riscos de integração
  • Gerir riscos de forma proativa
  • Propor planos de refatoração sem bloquear entregas de negócio


O que buscamos

Pessoas que:

Hard Skills

  • Têm domínio profundo de Flutter e Dart, incluindo a engine do Flutter e o ciclo de vida da linguagem
  • Têm experiência sólida em desenvolvimento e deploy para Android, iOS e Flutter Web
  • Compreendem as nuances de cada plataforma, incluindo gerenciamento de janelas, navegação web e mobile e bibliotecas específicas
  • Dominam arquiteturas escaláveis, como Clean Architecture e MVVM
  • Aplicam padrões de projeto que facilitam o reaproveitamento de código entre Web e Mobile
  • Têm experiência com Bloc ou Riverpod em projetos de alta complexidade e larga escala
  • Criam layouts responsivos e adaptativos com fidelidade ao Figma em diferentes plataformas
  • Dominam a pirâmide de testes (unitários, widget e integração)
  • Aplicam estratégias de CI/CD para automação de builds mobile e web
  • Debugam memory leaks e otimizam o tamanho do bundle web
  • Garantem performance fluida, com scroll a 60 FPS em diferentes dispositivos


Soft Skills

  • Tomam decisões estratégicas entre soluções customizadas e padrões do framework, visando a saúde do projeto no longo prazo
  • Comunicam-se de forma proativa e negociam contratos técnicos com Backend, Produto e Design

  • Compartilham conhecimento e estimulam a evolução coletiva

  • Antecipam riscos técnicos que impactam as releases semanais

  • Intermediate to advanced English
