title: Finance Manager
description:
About Us

Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.


Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.


As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.


Key Responsibilities

  • Oversee daily liquidity positioning in both BRL and digital assets, ensuring the firm meets all operational and regulatory obligations.
  • Maintain rigorous oversight of treasury-related accounting entries, ensuring accuracy in the general ledger and alignment with local Brazilian accounting standards.
  • Maintain accounting practices in strict accordance with the Accounting Standard for Institutions Regulated by the Central Bank of Brazil (COSIF), ensuring all financial statements are audit-ready.
  • Lead the preparation and timely submission of CADOC (Central Bank of Brazil Data Collection) reports, ensuring all financial data transmitted to regulators is accurate and consistent.
  • Implement and monitor ACAM frameworks to ensure the Brazilian entity remains within the risk appetite defined by the Central Bank and global HQ.
  • Develop and execute strategies to minimize idle cash, manage currency exposure (FX), and optimize transaction costs across local banking partners.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for local banking partners and regulatory bodies regarding treasury operations, audits, and financial inquiries.
  • Monitor market volatility and counterparty risk, implementing hedging strategies where necessary to protect the firm’s balance sheet.


Requirements

  • Experience: Minimum of 5–7 years of experience in Treasury, Corporate Finance, or Financial Operations, preferably within a Fintech, Bank, or Crypto-related institution.
  • Technical Knowledge: Deep understanding of Central Bank of Brazil (BCB) regulations.
  • Hands-on experience with CADOC reporting and ACAM risk management guidelines.
  • Strong background in Accounting (IFRS/CPC) and financial statement analysis.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Economics, Finance, or a related field. Professional certifications (e.g., CRC, CFA, or specialized Treasury certifications) are a significant plus.
  • Language Skills: Fluency in English and Portuguese is mandatory, as you will collaborate with global teams and local regulators.
  • Crypto Proficiency: Familiarity with blockchain technology, wallet management, including understanding of blockchain custody, proof of reserves methodologies, and the specific dynamics of the VASP market in Brazil.

title: Software Engineer
description:
Software Engineer (LLM & AI Integration)


As a Software Engineer specializing in LLM Integration, you’ll be responsible for owning our AI infrastructure, agentic workflows, and the integration of Large Language Models into our core product. You’ll design and implement end-to-end AI features that empower our users and internal teams to leverage generative intelligence. You will maintain a scalable production environment using frameworks like LangChain or LlamaIndex and ensure that model outputs are accurate, secure, and performant. This role is perfect for someone who combines traditional software engineering rigor with a passion for the evolving AI landscape.


What You'll Do

AI Infrastructure & LLM Development

  • Design, build, and maintain reliable services that interface with LLMs (OpenAI, Anthropic, or open-source models).
  • Implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines to ground model responses in proprietary data.
  • Build and optimize backend APIs and microservices to support AI-driven features.
  • Develop robust prompt engineering strategies and evaluation frameworks to ensure output quality.
  • Document AI system architecture, model versioning, and integration patterns.

Product Integration & Collaboration

  • Collaborate with Product, Design, and Engineering teams to define user-facing AI capabilities.
  • Translate complex business requirements into technical AI solutions (e.g., automated support, intelligent search, or content generation).
  • Optimize model latency and token usage for cost-effective and snappy user experiences.
  • Support front-end teams in delivering seamless AI interactions.

Data Engineering for AI

  • Write and optimize SQL queries and vector database schemas (e.g., Pinecone, Weaviate, or Milvus).
  • Implement data preprocessing and embedding pipelines to prepare unstructured data for LLM consumption.
  • Establish best practices for fine-tuning models or managing few-shot learning datasets.
  • Monitoring & AI Ops
  • Monitor LLM performance, \"hallucination\" rates, and API health proactively.
  • Implement guardrails, moderation layers, and validation processes for AI safety.
  • Maintain CI/CD pipelines for AI services and manage model deployments.
  • Stay updated on the latest research in NLP, LLM orchestration, and agentic frameworks.


What You'll Bring

  • 3–5 years of professional experience in Software Engineering, Backend Development, or AI/ML Engineering.
  • Strong Python proficiency, specifically in building scalable backend systems and working with asynchronous programming.
  • Hands-on experience with LLM frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, or Haystack.
  • Solid understanding of RAG architectures, vector databases, and embedding techniques.
  • Proven ability to work with RESTful APIs and Cloud Infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
  • Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams to ship production-grade software features.


Key Skills

  • Problem Solver: Analytical thinker who can debug complex, non-deterministic AI behaviors.
  • Communicator: Excellent skills for explaining technical AI constraints to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Self-Starter: Ability to take ownership of the AI roadmap in a fast-paced environment.
  • Detail-Oriented: Commitment to software craftsmanship, code quality, and AI safety.


Nice to Have

  • Advanced experience with Vector Databases (Pinecone, Chroma, Qdrant).
  • Familiarity with LLM Evaluation tools (Ragas, TruLens, or LangSmith).
  • Experience with deployment orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes, or Serverless functions).
  • Knowledge of fine-tuning techniques and libraries like Hugging Face transformers or peft.
  • Prior work in a startup environment where rapid prototyping and iteration are key.


Why Join Us?

You’ll play a critical role in defining our AI strategy from the ground up. We offer a flexible, fully remote work environment where you’ll have the autonomy to choose the best tools for the job and make a massive impact on our product’s evolution. Your work will directly define how our customers interact with the next generation of intelligent software.

Mais do que uma mudança de nome, a AXIA representa a evolução de uma companhia sólida, que vem se transformando para atuar com mais agilidade, inovação e foco no cliente em um setor em constante movimento. A nova marca traduz energia, conexão, história e futuro.

Com presença em todas as regiões do país, nosso foco é oferecer soluções completas que catalisem resultados, impulsionando o desenvolvimento do setor e transformando energia em oportunidades para pessoas, negócios e para o planeta.

Na AXIA Energia, o futuro é movido pela potência de quem acredita em transformar. Venha viver o novo com a gente!

ATENÇÃO: A AXIA Energia não cobra taxas para realização de testes, exames ou participação no processo seletivo.

title: Tech Lead Fullstack- Node/React
description:
Principais Responsabilidades

2.1. Arquitetura e Estratégia Técnica

● Definição de Soluções: Decidir sobre a estrutura do software, stacks tecnológicos e frameworks, assegurando que as escolhas atendam aos requisitos funcionais e não-funcionais (performance, segurança, escalabilidade).

● Visão de Longo Prazo: Garantir que as decisões técnicas atuais não criem dívida técnica insustentável e estejam alinhadas com os objetivos gerais da empresa.

● Análise de Viabilidade: Avaliar solicitações de produto sob a ótica técnica antes do início do desenvolvimento.

2.2. Gestão Técnica e Qualidade

● Guardião da Qualidade: Estabelecer e fiscalizar padrões de desenvolvimento (Clean Code, SOLID), fluxos de Git e estratégias de testes automatizados.

● Revisão de Código (Code Review): Atuar ativamente nos Pull Requests não apenas para aprovar, mas para garantir conformidade com a arquitetura e identificar falhas de segurança ou lógica.

● Gestão de Riscos: Identificar gargalos técnicos ou riscos de integração antecipadamente, propondo planos de mitigação.

2.3. Liderança e Mentoria (People Development)

● Mentoria Técnica: Orientar desenvolvedores (Juniores, Plenos e Seniores), ajudando-os a superar bloqueios técnicos e incentivando as melhores práticas.

● Promoção da Autonomia: Delegar tarefas complexas com supervisão, permitindo que o time cresça, evitando a centralização do conhecimento no Tech Lead.

● Apoio ao Crescimento: Fornecer feedback técnico construtivo para apoiar o desenvolvimento profissional dos membros da equipe.

2.4. Comunicação e Ponte com Negócios

● Tradução de Requisitos: Converter necessidades de negócio (do Product Manager ou Cliente) em requisitos técnicos claros e acionáveis para os desenvolvedores.

● Facilitação: Atuar como interlocutor técnico em reuniões com outras áreas ou clientes, protegendo o time de interrupções desnecessárias e clarificando dúvidas técnicas.


Requisitos



Proficiência em React (com TypeScript, Next.js, Vite, SASS, Jest) para o frontend e Node.js (com Express, NestJS, GraphQL, APIs REST) para o backend, além de bancos de dados (PostgreSQL, MongoDB), ferramentas de versionamento (Git), CI/CD (Docker, Jenkins/AWS) e soft skills como comunicação e trabalho em equipe, focando em desenvolvimento escalável, testes e boas práticas de engenharia.

title: Technical Account Manager
description:
Technical Account Manager – Telecom Software


Iquall es una compañía de software especializada en automatización y transformación de redes para operadores de telecomunicaciones. Trabajamos con grandes carriers, ayudándolos a modernizar su operación, automatizar procesos críticos y evolucionar la gestión de la red hacia modelos más eficientes y autónomos. Somos una empresa con fuerte ADN técnico, pero con visión comercial y foco en crecimiento sostenible. Nuestro modelo combina coherencia comercial, credibilidad técnica y ejecución sólida.


Buscamos un Technical Account Manager (TAM) con fuerte perfil estratégico y orientación al cliente para gestionar cuentas clave (Tier-1) dentro del sector telecom. El TAM es responsable de gestionar integralmente la cuenta desde lo técnico-comercial. No es un rol de soporte ni de delivery operativo. Es quien entiende los desafíos del cliente, influye en su planificación futura y construye oportunidades sostenibles. El rol combina visión técnica, desarrollo de negocio y acompañamiento post-venta para asegurar la generación de valor continuo y la adopción de nuestras soluciones de automatización.


Principales Responsabilidades

Gestión Estratégica y Desarrollo de Negocio:

  • Comprender la estructura tecnológica, operativa y presupuestaria del cliente, alineando nuestras soluciones con sus iniciativas de transformación digital y eficiencia operativa.
  • Detectar iniciativas y problemas estructurales antes de que se conviertan en procesos formales de licitación (RFPs).
  • Generar proactivamente oportunidades de upselling y cross-selling sobre la base instalada (\"budget fishing\").
  • Influir en la planificación futura y las líneas presupuestarias del cliente.

Venta Consultiva (Soluciones Estándar):

  • Diseñar y presentar de forma autónoma propuestas técnico-comerciales cuando la solución se base en el portafolio existente de Iquall.
  • Traducir capacidades complejas de producto en soluciones claras, viables y con sentido económico para el cliente.

Relacionamiento y Evangelización:

  • Construir vínculos sólidos y gestionar múltiples stakeholders dentro de organizaciones complejas, manteniendo credibilidad tanto frente a equipos de ingeniería/operativos como áreas ejecutivas (C-Level).
  • Orquestar workshops y sesiones ejecutivas (\"Overview Demos\") para mostrar el arte de lo posible e impulsar la adopción de nuevas funcionalidades.
  • Continuidad Post-Venta (Value Delivery):
  • Asegurar la correcta implementación y adopción de las soluciones vendidas.
  • Coordinar la transición hacia la ejecución junto a los Project Managers (PMs) y Delivery, identificando riesgos tempranos, pero sin gestionar la operación directamente.


Requisitos Excluyentes:

  • Experiencia: 5+ años en roles de gestión técnica de cuentas, consultoría técnica o ingeniería de ventas (Pre-Sales) con fuerte componente relacional y orientados a resultados comerciales.
  • Industria: Experiencia sólida trabajando con operadores de telecomunicaciones (Tier-1 preferentemente), conocimiento de operaciones, arquitectura de red (fija, móvi, Cloudl, ej. FTTH, 4G/5G), y plataformas OSS/BSS.
  • Formación: Título universitario en Ingeniería (Telecomunicaciones, Sistemas, Electrónica) o carrera técnica equivalente.
  • Idiomas: Dominio fluido de inglés y español.
  • Habilidades Técnicas: Conocimiento conceptual de software, modelos de despliegue (Cloud, SaaS, On-premise), APIs e integración. Familiaridad con los marcos de trabajo de la industria (ej. estándares TM Forum, eTOM, Open APIs). Entendimiento suficiente para influir técnicamente sin necesidad de ejecutar configuraciones profundas (hands-on).
  • Competencias: Comunicación técnica a nivel ejecutivo, capacidad para traducir problemas operativos en impacto de negocio, pensamiento estratégico a largo plazo y excelentes habilidades de negociación.
  • Disponibilidad: Para viajar atendiendo el territorio asignado.


Deseable

  • Experiencia previa y cartera de contactos en cuentas Tier-1 de la región.
  • Certificaciones en gestión de proyectos (PMP o similares) o Metodologías Agile.
  • Formación de posgrado en gestión tecnológica o negocios.


Qué Ofrecemos

  • Rol estratégico con impacto directo en el crecimiento de la compañía.
  • Trabajo con operadores de telecomunicaciones de primer nivel.
  • Participación en proyectos de automatización reales y de vanguardia.
  • Espacio para crecer profesionalmente combinando tecnología de alto nivel y negocio.

title: DGB Americas Regional Sales Manager
description:
Job Title: Regional Sales Manager

Department: Sales Distributors/TR

Location: Brazil


About DG Beauty:

Dolce & Gabbana Beauty is part of the global Dolce & Gabbana Group, embodying the brand’s bold identity, Italian heritage, and commitment to excellence. Our Beauty division continues to grow rapidly across fragrance and beauty categories, driven by strong partnerships, high-performance teams, and a focus on Retail Excellence.


Role Overview:

The Retail Sales Executive is responsible for driving sales performance, market share growth, and brand excellence within an assigned geographic area and client portfolio. This role plays a critical part in executing commercial strategies, managing field teams, and building strong, long-term partnerships with retail clients while ensuring consistent brand execution at point of sale.

The Retail Sales Executive works closely with the Area Manager and cross-functional teams to deliver results aligned with business objectives, brand guidelines, and budget expectations.


Key Job Accountabilities:

Sales Growth & Market Share

  • Increase sales and gain market share in line with targets set by the Area Manager.
  • Achieve monthly sales growth above market through execution of the Action Plan and promotional initiatives.

Client Management & Commercial Development

  • Motivate and manage clients within the assigned geographic area and portfolio.
  • Coordinate sales development in line with brand guidelines and client needs.
  • Build strong, positive, and long-term relationships to strengthen client loyalty and partnership.

Field Team Leadership

  • Manage Beauty Advisors and temporary payroll agency resources.
  • Support hiring, onboarding, development, coaching, and motivation of field teams.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner effectively with Training, Marketing, Merchandising, Finance, and Customer Service.
  • Align cross-functional support to deliver sales objectives and operational excellence.

Retail Excellence & Brand Execution

  • Contribute to Retail Excellence at point of sale.
  • Ensure brand image, visual standards, and merchandising guidelines are consistently respected.

Market Analysis & Assortment Optimization

  • Analyze market trends, competition, and customer insights to identify opportunities.
  • Review and optimize client assortment with focus on best sellers and inventory health.

Budget & Investment Management

  • Manage travel expense budgets and A&P investments for assigned clients.
  • Measure ROI of promotional and commercial activities in coordination with the Area Manager.

Key Responsibilities

  • Execute sales strategies and promotional plans across assigned accounts.
  • Conduct regular store visits to coach teams, assess execution, and monitor performance.
  • Ensure flawless execution of product launches and in-store initiatives.
  • Monitor KPIs, sales results, and productivity metrics, providing insights and action plans when needed.
  • Maintain accurate reporting and timely communication with internal stakeholders.


Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field preferred.
  • Minimum of 3–5 years of experience in retail sales, field sales, or account management within beauty, luxury, or consumer goods.
  • Proven experience managing field teams and working with retail partners.
  • Strong understanding of retail operations, visual merchandising, and commercial execution.
  • Experience working with budgets, forecasts, and ROI tracking.


Travel Requirements

  • Frequent travel within the assigned geographic area, including overnight stays as required.

title: Customer Success Manager (Brazil) — PRM SaaS (Eastern Time Hours)
description:
About Magentrix

Magentrix is a PRM (Partner Relationship Management) SaaS platform that helps companies scale with partners. We power secure partner portals that drive adoption, collaboration, and revenue. Our customers span software, manufacturing, and services; our team values ownership, curiosity, and measurable outcomes.


Role Overview

We’re hiring a Customer Success Manager based in Brazil to own a portfolio of international customers. Your focus is on outcomes such as retention, expansion, adoption, and advocacy. You’ll work with leadership to set clear goals and co-create practical plans (onboarding/time-to-value, adoption plans, save plans). What You’ll Do

·       Lead EBRs, multi-thread stakeholders, and manage renewals/expansions with clear next steps

·       Monitor health signals and usage, identify risks early and execute save plans

·       Lead discovery to understand business use cases and pain points, design portal configurations and workflows that solve them, and clearly document and present the solution to customers

·       Translate business goals into clear requirements and coordinate with Support, Product, and Services

·       Capture learnings, improve playbooks, and contribute voice-of-customer insights to the roadmap


Requirements (Must-Haves)

·       Fluent English (written and spoken) ; confident facilitating executive meetings and EBRs

·       5+ years  in SaaS Customer Success or adjacent roles (consulting, account management, product enablement) with measurable renewal/adoption results

·       Solution engineering capability  in a SaaS environment, able to run discovery, map requirements to portal capabilities, design configurations and workflows, explain trade offs, and handle live product Q&A with customers

·       You’ve contributed to or improved an onboarding/TTV plan, save play, or EBR narrative

·       Comfort balancing autonomy and coaching, able to propose approaches, accept feedback, and refine quickly

·       Strong stakeholder management and clear written communication

·       Analytical skills (spreadsheets/BI) to interpret product usage, set KPIs, and make data-backed decisions

·       Familiarity with PRM/CRM concepts (partner onboarding, deal registration, content/enablement workflows)


Preferred Qualifications

·       Experience with PRM, CRM, or portal products (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot)

·       Exposure to global SaaS motions (serving North America/EMEA)

·       Technically self-sufficient in a SaaS environment, able to run live module demos, handle product Q&A, and perform light configuration or troubleshooting during customer calls

·       Working grasp of web and SaaS fundamentals, for example HTTP and JSON basics, user roles and permissions, data mapping, environments

·       Conceptual understanding of SSO standards such as SAML or OIDC

·       Comfort mapping data between PRM and CRM, managing CSV imports and exports, and validating data quality during onboarding and expansion

·       Ability to translate business goals into configurations or clear technical tickets and partner effectively with Support and Product


Location & Working Hours

·       Brazil-based (fully remote )

·       Full overlap with Eastern Time (ET)  working hours


What We Offer

·       Market-aligned compensation with outcome-based variable tied to GRR/NRR

·       Clear goals, regular coaching, and a path to increased scope based on results

·       Autonomy within established guardrails to test approaches and iterate with data

·       High visibility with leadership and direct impact on customer outcomes

·       Structured feedback, documented playbooks, and opportunities to present learnings


How to Apply

Submit your CV in English , and one paragraph  describing how you would approach the first 60 days after a new client’s go-live  in a PRM or partner-portal context, include your assumptions, your definition of time-to-first-value, the key milestones you would drive, and how you would measure progress.

title: Supervisor de Enfermagem - Unidade de Internação Pediátrica Oncológica
description:
Requisitos:



- Superior completo em Enfermagem;

-Pós graduação em área assistencial;

-COREN ativo e dentro da validade;

-Necessário boa vivência com gestão de equipes, experiência na área assistencial, com oncologia pediátrica.




Atividades:


- Tomar ciência, diariamente, das orientações constantes do livro de Ordens e Ocorrências e demais anotações, a fim de tomar ciência das intercorrências ocorridas no plantão diurno possibilitando dar continuidade aos tratamentos dos pacientes;


- Com base na escala mensal de funcionários, recebida da Gerência de Enfermagem, conferir diariamente a presença, atrasos, licença médicas e trocas de plantão realizado pelos funcionários, anotando no livro de ordens e ocorrência as divergências encontradas;


- Inspecionar, diariamente, os Setores de Enfermagem da Unidade, avaliando a qualidade de assistência prestada e identificando a necessidade de utilização de equipamentos e remanejamento de pessoal para prestação de atendimento adequado, bem como se as equipes estão utilizando o uniforme padrão da Unidade, com seus respectivos equipamentos de segurança;


- Orientar as atividades desenvolvidas pelos Enfermeiros Plantonistas, na realização de suas atividades diárias, bem como observando e orientando aspectos de desvio de comportamentos, a fim de corrigir os problemas com colaboradores no seu turno;


- Atender os clientes e seus acompanhantes, quando solicitado, esclarecendo as dúvidas apresentadas, bem como providenciando a solução aos superiores de plantão, caso o assunto fuja dos limites de sua autonomia;


- Garantir o cumprimento das Instruções Operacionais Técnicas e Administrativas do serviço noturno como: preparo pré-operatório, pré-exames, transferência de pacientes, conferência de material/medicação, requisição de farmácia, registrando as intercorrências e dificuldades encontradas no plantão no livro de Ordens e Ocorrências;


- Apoiar a Recepção de Internação propondo e encaminhando soluções inerentes a liberação de quarto ou leito, a fim de facilitar o processo de internação de novos ou transferências internas de pacientes;


- Acionar, quando necessário, o Setor de Engenharia Clínica, visando providenciar o reparo de equipamentos defeituosos na Unidade, durante seu plantão;


- Acompanhar e orientar situações de acidentes de trabalho ocorridos no seu turno, encaminhando os acidentados ao Setor de Emergência, bem como comunicando ao Setor de Medicina e Segurança do Trabalho as ocorrências;


- Intermediar situações que necessitem de auxílio a outras Unidades da Rede, obtendo autorização superior para os casos de: empréstimo de materiais e equipamentos médico-hospitalares, uso de autoclave e etc;


- Participar da elaboração de manuais de rotinas ou POPs, junto com as áreas de CCIH, Qualidade e Educação Continuada, a fim de contribuir para a implantação de processo de melhores práticas de assistência hospitalar;


- Testar materiais e equipamentos novos e responder pareceres técnicos enviados pelos setores de padronização e engenharia clínica respectivamente para análise e decisão sobre a utilização/aquisição.





Outras informações:

Barra da Tijuca - RJ.



- Escala de trabalho:

200h - 07h às 16h.



- Disponibilidade para treinamento.

Este grupo multinacional líder, com operações significativas nas Américas e em todo o mundo, busca um Gerente de Investigação Forense experiente para liderar uma equipe de investigadores corporativos em suas operações regionais.

We are seeking a Senior JDE Developer who is a true \"Hybrid\" professional—an expert coder who deeply understands the functional logic of Brazil Localization and Global Trade Compliance.

In this role, you will be the technical anchor for a major Global Manufacturing client. You will be responsible for the seamless connection between JDE EnterpriseOne and external Fiscal/Trade engines (e.g., Thomson Reuters, Synchro, or similar). We need someone who understands the \"plumbing\" of Brazil localization—how data flows between JDE and external messaging systems for NFe, GFe, and tax calculations.

  • Brazil Localization Mastery: Expert knowledge of NFe (Nota Fiscal Eletrônica) and GFe (Freight Management) workflows.

  • Core JDE Development: Expert-level mastery of RDA, FDA, BDA, TDA, and C BSFNs.

  • Modern Frameworks: Expert use of UDOs (E1 Pages, Watchlists, Personalizations) and BI Publisher.
  • Functional Awareness: Ability to act as a \"Technical-Functional Bridge,\" understanding the business process flow behind the technical specifications.


Key Responsibilities

  • System Integration: Maintain and optimize the \"connectors\" between JDE and external fiscal/trade applications to ensure 100% compliance.
  • Strategic Problem Solving: Provide Level 1–3 support with a focus on root-cause analysis and long-term architectural stability.
  • Collaborative Design: Partner with functional leads and business stakeholders to translate Brazilian regulatory changes into robust JDE solutions.

Languages & Education

  • Portuguese: Required (Native/Fluent).

  • Spanish: A significant plus (for collaboration across our LATAM footprint).
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in IT/CS OR 10+ years of verifiable Senior JDE experience.


Apply with your CV in English.

title: UI Designer
description:
About Lilo Social

Lilo Social is a full-funnel eCommerce growth agency specializing in acquisition and retention for direct-to-consumer brands. With a team of over 75 professionals, we deliver best-in-class paid media, email marketing, and creative services to help brands scale profitably. We work across the entire customer lifecycle, from content creation and paid advertising to conversion rate optimization and retention marketing.


Our partnership-first approach has earned us a 90% client retention rate and recognition as an Inc. 5000 honoree for three consecutive years (2023, 2024, 2025). We are proud to be a Klaviyo Master Elite Agency, a distinction held by only 0.2% of Klaviyo's 6,500+ partners. To date, we have driven billions of dollars in attributed revenue for our partners.


The Role

The UI Designer is a key contributor to Lilo Social's conversion rate optimization practice, responsible for designing high-performing Shopify storefronts and direct-response landing pages for a portfolio of 8- and 9-figure DTC brands. This role sits at the intersection of aesthetics and performance, translating CRO strategy, A/B test hypotheses, and brand guidelines into polished, conversion-optimized digital experiences. You will work closely with CRO strategists, developers, and client partners to bring designs from concept to implementation with precision and speed.


What Success Looks Like

  • Measurable improvements in CVR, AOV, and on-site engagement metrics across your client portfolio
  • High-quality design deliverables that are executed on-brief, on-brand, and on deadline
  • A consistent output of test-ready page variations that support an active A/B testing roadmap
  • Strong cross-functional relationships with CRO strategists and developers that accelerate design-to-launch velocity


Responsibilities

  • Design Shopify storefront experiences including homepages, product detail pages, collection pages, and cart/checkout flows optimized for conversion
  • Develop high-converting landing pages for paid media campaigns, promotional offers, and subscription acquisition
  • Translate CRO hypotheses and A/B test briefs into polished, production-ready design mockups using Figma
  • Apply direct response design principles to every deliverable, balancing visual quality with performance intent
  • Collaborate with CRO strategists to understand test objectives, user behavior data, and optimization priorities before beginning design work
  • Iterate rapidly on design concepts based on A/B test results, heatmap analysis, and qualitative feedback
  • Maintain and evolve client-specific design systems and component libraries in Figma to ensure brand consistency at scale
  • Handoff designs to developers with annotated specs, interaction notes, and responsive behavior defined
  • Review implemented pages against design intent and provide precise QA feedback prior to launch
  • Participate in client-facing design reviews and communicate design rationale clearly and professionally
  • Stay current on DTC eCommerce design trends, Shopify theme capabilities, and emerging CRO best practices


Requirements

  • 3+ years of UI design experience, with a portfolio demonstrating Shopify storefront and landing page work for eCommerce brands
  • Expert proficiency in Figma, including component libraries, auto layout, and developer handoff workflows
  • Deep understanding of direct response design principles and how layout, hierarchy, copy placement, and visual cues drive conversion
  • Proven experience designing within or alongside A/B testing frameworks (Intelligems, Convert, VWO, Optimizely, or similar)
  • Strong understanding of responsive design and mobile-first design principles
  • Ability to interpret quantitative data (CVR, bounce rate, scroll depth, heatmaps) and translate insights into design decisions
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to present and defend design decisions to internal teams and client stakeholders


Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with Shopify theme structure, Liquid templating, or experience working directly within Shopify Online Store 2.0
  • Experience with tools such as Hotjar, Microsoft Clarity, Google Optimize, or similar UX research and testing platforms
  • Basic proficiency in HTML/CSS sufficient to support developer QA and minor implementation edits
  • Background in DTC subscription brands or experience designing subscription-specific UX (subscribe-and-save, upsell flows, portal pages)
  • Motion or micro-interaction design experience using Figma prototyping or After Effects


Compensation and Benefits

  • Generous Time Off: Competitive PTO policy and paid holidays to maintain work-life balance
  • Fully Remote: Work from anywhere with flexible hours and a distributed team culture
  • Compensation: Competitive salary commensurate with experience.

title: Viral Video Scout
description:
Turn Your Love of Viral Videos Into Income


Freelance Viral Video Scout (Remote – Global)


Company: Caters Media Group


Payment: Fixed fee per signed video


About Us

Caters Media Group is a leading international multimedia agency specialising in sourcing and licensing compelling video content to major global media outlets. We work with broadcasters, publishers and digital platforms around the world — and we’re always looking for the next viral moment before it hits the mainstream.

Many of our most successful scouts are people who already spend time discovering trending videos online. If you regularly spot viral moments before they explode across the internet, this could be an opportunity to turn that instinct into income.


The Opportunity

We are looking for motivated, self-driven individuals to join our global network of freelance Viral Video Scouts.

Your role will involve identifying compelling real-life videos online and helping us connect with the original creators so the content can be licensed to global media outlets.


Your responsibilities include:

Discover viral, newsworthy or emotionally compelling videos

Identify and verify the original creator of the content

Introduce creators to the opportunity to have their video licensed through Caters Media Group

Build rapport and, where required, speak with creators via phone or video call to explain how licensing works

Help secure signed agreements allowing Caters Media Group to represent the video

You earn a fixed fee for every video you successfully introduce that results in a signed licensing agreement.


No targets.

No fixed hours.

Work from anywhere.

Work when you want.


How It Works

You complete initial training with our team

We teach you what makes video content commercially valuable

We guide you on verifying ownership and introducing creators to the licensing opportunity

After training, you work independently identifying opportunities


You receive a fixed payment for each successfully signed video.


Your earnings depend on both the number of videos you secure and the quality and suitability of those submissions for licensing.


A fixed fee is paid once a creator has signed a licensing agreement with Caters Media Group for a video you introduced, and the video meets our internal quality and editorial guidelines.


All video submissions and creator agreements are subject to verification and approval by Caters Media Group before payment is issued.


This role is offered on an independent freelance basis and does not constitute employment with Caters Media Group.


What We’re Looking For

You don’t need formal qualifications — but you do need:

A sharp eye for viral and newsworthy video content

Confidence communicating with content creators

A strong standard of spoken and written English

The ability to speak with creators via phone or video call to explain licensing opportunities clearly and professionally

Self-motivation and initiative

Good time management


This role is ideal for people who:

Follow trending videos across multiple platforms daily

Enjoy spotting viral moments before they reach mainstream media

Understand the difference between original footage and reposted content

Enjoy identifying compelling real-life stories and moments

Are comfortable communicating with new people

Want flexible earning potential alongside other commitments

Are budding journalists interested in developing their news sense and editorial instincts

Work in journalism, media, or content creation and are looking to generate additional income alongside their existing work

If you regularly spot videos before they reach major news outlets, this role could be a strong fit.


  What This Is (And Isn’t)


✅ Flexible freelance opportunity 

✅ Fixed fee per signed video

✅ Work from anywhere

✅ Initial training provided

✅ No fixed hours

✅ No minimum targets

❌ Not a salaried role

❌ No guaranteed income

❌ Not suited to those uncomfortable speaking with creators directly


Important

Due to the high number of applications we receive, only candidates who follow the application instructions carefully and complete the example task will be considered.

Applications that do not meet the requirements below may not be reviewed.


Application Requirements

All applications must be submitted in English.

Please include the following:

Attach your CV / Resume in English

Tell us which social media platforms you use most frequently

Explain why you believe you would be good at identifying licensable video content

Example Video Task

Please provide one example of a recent viral video that you believe could generate licensing revenue.

The video must:

Be posted on the social media account of the original video owner (the person who filmed the content)

Have been posted within the last 24 hours

Include a direct link to the video

Along with the link, please include 2–3 sentences explaining why you believe the video has licensing potential.

Ownership Check - In one or two sentences, explain how you have determined that the person posting the video is the original owner of the footage.

To confirm you have read the full application instructions, please include the word “Scout” in the subject line of your application email.

title: Customer Success Manager (Brazil) — PRM SaaS (Eastern Time Hours)
description:
About Magentrix

Magentrix is a PRM (Partner Relationship Management) SaaS platform that helps companies scale with partners. We power secure partner portals that drive adoption, collaboration, and revenue. Our customers span software, manufacturing, and services; our team values ownership, curiosity, and measurable outcomes.


Role Overview

We’re hiring a Customer Success Manager based in Brazil to own a portfolio of international customers. Your focus is on outcomes such as retention, expansion, adoption, and advocacy. You’ll work with leadership to set clear goals and co-create practical plans (onboarding/time-to-value, adoption plans, save plans). You will act as a solution engineer, translating business problems and use cases into pragmatic portal solutions that deliver measurable value. You’ll have autonomy to try approaches that work for your customers and regular coaching to help you make it happen.


What You’ll Do

·       Own a customer book and deliver on GRR, NRR, adoption, and NPS targets

·       Co-create and run onboarding/time-to-value and adoption plans using templates, playbooks, and your ideas, iterate using data and customer feedback

·       Lead EBRs, multi-thread stakeholders, and manage renewals/expansions with clear next steps

·       Monitor health signals and usage, identify risks early and execute save plans

·       Lead discovery to understand business use cases and pain points, design portal configurations and workflows that solve them, and clearly document and present the solution to customers

·       Translate business goals into clear requirements and coordinate with Support, Product, and Services

·       Capture learnings, improve playbooks, and contribute voice-of-customer insights to the roadmap


Requirements (Must-Haves)

·       Fluent English (written and spoken) ; confident facilitating executive meetings and EBRs

·       5+ years  in SaaS Customer Success or adjacent roles (consulting, account management, product enablement) with measurable renewal/adoption results

·       Solution engineering capability  in a SaaS environment, able to run discovery, map requirements to portal capabilities, design configurations and workflows, explain trade offs, and handle live product Q&A with customers

·       You’ve contributed to or improved an onboarding/TTV plan, save play, or EBR narrative

·       Comfort balancing autonomy and coaching, able to propose approaches, accept feedback, and refine quickly

·       Strong stakeholder management and clear written communication

·       Analytical skills (spreadsheets/BI) to interpret product usage, set KPIs, and make data-backed decisions

·       Familiarity with PRM/CRM concepts (partner onboarding, deal registration, content/enablement workflows)


Preferred Qualifications

·       Experience with PRM, CRM, or portal products (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot)

·       Exposure to global SaaS motions (serving North America/EMEA)

·       Technically self-sufficient in a SaaS environment, able to run live module demos, handle product Q&A, and perform light configuration or troubleshooting during customer calls

·       Working grasp of web and SaaS fundamentals, for example HTTP and JSON basics, user roles and permissions, data mapping, environments

·       Conceptual understanding of SSO standards such as SAML or OIDC

·       Comfort mapping data between PRM and CRM, managing CSV imports and exports, and validating data quality during onboarding and expansion

·       Ability to translate business goals into configurations or clear technical tickets and partner effectively with Support and Product


Location & Working Hours

·       Brazil-based (fully remote )

·       Full overlap with Eastern Time (ET)  working hours


What We Offer

·       Market-aligned compensation with outcome-based variable tied to GRR/NRR

·       Clear goals, regular coaching, and a path to increased scope based on results

·       Autonomy within established guardrails to test approaches and iterate with data

·       High visibility with leadership and direct impact on customer outcomes

·       Structured feedback, documented playbooks, and opportunities to present learnings


How to Apply

Submit your CV in English , and one paragraph  describing how you would approach the first 60 days after a new client’s go-live  in a PRM or partner-portal context, include your assumptions, your definition of time-to-first-value, the key milestones you would drive, and how you would measure progress.

title: Application Support Specialist

That's you:   

  • Previous Support experience in IT.  
  • Strong SQL skills: ability to connect the database, ability to execute and create SQL queries.  
  • Hands-on experience working with APIs .  
  • Certified within Azure and/or M365 certification roadmap (e.g., Azure Fundamentals, Azure Administrator, Microsoft 365 Certified: Fundamentals or Associate level).
  • Fluent English (verbal and written).  
  • Experience with Microsoft Cloud technologies (Azure) .

  • Experience with licensing and invoices is a plus.

  • Ability to work as part of a team.  
  • Ability to make quick decisions, align priorities and execute tasks.  
  • Be able to stay calm under pressure.  
  • Ability to communicate well and precisely.  


Why join AppXite:

  • Remote-First Flexibility: Enjoy the freedom of a fully remote role.

Além da administração dos direitos de forma coletiva, a Interartis Brasil também promove atividades de cunho social e educacional em benefício dos associados.


Em 2025, lançamos \"Jornada da Criação: como gerar conteúdo e engajamento nas redes\" , uma formação online e gratuita voltada a artistas, criadores e profissionais da cultura que desejam aprimorar sua presença digital e aprender a usar as redes como aliadas do trabalho artístico. A \"Jornada da Criação\"  conta com patrocínio da Meta , por meio da Lei de Incentivo à Cultura.

Auxilia nas atividades de análise de crédito, faturamento, contas a receber e cobrança, atuando sob supervisão para garantir o processamento preciso e pontual das transações de crédito e contas a receber. Contribui para a eficiência e eficácia das operações do departamento.

ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.

Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.

E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

title: Principal Technical Support Engineer (Remote)
description:
In our 'always on' world, we believe it's essential to have a genuine connection with the work you do.


We are excited to announce that we are hiring a Principal Technical Support Engineer in working from Brazil remotely to join our team and provide high‑level technical expertise to our Ruckus Premium (BullDog) customers.


Your primary responsibility is to serve as a key technical resource, delivering expert assistance and ensuring prompt resolution of complex customer issues.


How You'll Help Us Connect the World:


You work directly with customers to troubleshoot problems, isolate root causes, and drive cases to closure with a high level of technical accuracy and professionalism. When needed, you reproduce customer scenarios in the Support Lab to validate findings and deepen understanding of the issue.

You collaborate closely with Engineering teams to manage escalations, resolve product bugs, and ensure that long-term corrective actions are identified and implemented. Throughout each case, you provide consistent updates to sales teams, internal management, and customers, maintaining clear communication and transparency at every stage.


Given the nature of the role, you are expected to support a staggered work week when required (such as Sunday through Thursday or Tuesday through Saturday) and participate in a rotating on-call schedule. Flexibility in work hours is essential to accommodate urgent customer needs. You thoroughly document customer interactions, engineering engagements, and action plans to ensure high-quality case management and knowledge continuity.


Beyond case handling, you contribute to the organization by creating and refining knowledge articles, troubleshooting guides, and internal training materials. You provide mentoring and coaching to team members to help strengthen overall team capability. You also participate regularly in customer and internal conference calls for high-profile cases and escalations, ensuring issues receive appropriate visibility. All responsibilities are carried out with strict adherence to Service Level Agreement KPIs.


Required Qualifications for Consideration:


  • 8+ years of experience working in the networking space
  • 5+ years of experience working in a TAC
  • Excellent written and oral communication ability, including formal presentation skills to customers, partners, Ruckus accounts and support teams
  • Excellent understanding and applied knowledge of TCP/IP, L3 routing, L2 switching, Multicast, firewalls, QOS
  • Solid understanding and troubleshooting skills with wireless technologies 802.11x, WLAN authentication, encryption, EAP, PSK, Radius, AAA, DNS
  • Expertise of wireless deployments – AP’s, Controllers, Client associations, etc
  • Excellent understanding of RF transmission and antenna behavior
  • Technical expertise in troubleshooting and resolving complex Layer 2/3 and/or wireless issues in multi-vendor environments
  • Experience providing support to direct customers, resellers, and field personnel in resolving company product related issues
  • Ability to provide technical guidance to other members in the team
  • Experience working in a support lab environment for problem replication
  • Experience documenting the sequence of events related to resolving customer technical issues
  • Proficient with analyzing data traces from protocol analyzers such as Wireshark
  • High level of English.
  • Available Monday through Friday or ‘staggered work week’s, i.e. Sunday through Thursday or Tuesday through Saturday and weekend or overnight hours as required.




Important Candidate Notice : On January 9, 2026, CommScope finalized the sale of its Connectivity and Cable Solutions segment, which included the CommScope name and brand, to Amphenol Corporation. The remaining businesses — Access Networks Solutions (now rebranded as Aurora Networks ) and RUCKUS Networks have been unified under the new parent company, renamed as Vistance Networks . The role being advertised is part of RUCKUS Networks.


Why Join Us?

Vistance Networks shapes the future of communications technology, pushing past what is possible. We deliver solutions that bring reliability and performance to a world always in motion. Our global team of innovators and employees are trusted advisors who listen to customers first, then deliver value.


RUCKUS Networks delivers purpose-driven enterprise networks that enable superior business outcomes in demanding environments. Our solutions combine AI-powered automation, proactive network assurance, and context-aware security, providing exceptional performance with simplified management.


If you want to grow your career alongside bright, passionate, and caring people who strive to create what's next…..come connect to your future at Vistance Networks.


Vistance Networks is an Equal Opportunity Employer (EEO), including people with disabilities and veterans.

title: UI Designer
description:
About Lilo Social

Lilo Social is a full-funnel eCommerce growth agency specializing in acquisition and retention for direct-to-consumer brands. With a team of over 75 professionals, we deliver best-in-class paid media, email marketing, and creative services to help brands scale profitably. We work across the entire customer lifecycle, from content creation and paid advertising to conversion rate optimization and retention marketing.


Our partnership-first approach has earned us a 90% client retention rate and recognition as an Inc. 5000 honoree for three consecutive years (2023, 2024, 2025). We are proud to be a Klaviyo Master Elite Agency, a distinction held by only 0.2% of Klaviyo's 6,500+ partners. To date, we have driven billions of dollars in attributed revenue for our partners.


The Role

The UI Designer is a key contributor to Lilo Social's conversion rate optimization practice, responsible for designing high-performing Shopify storefronts and direct-response landing pages for a portfolio of 8- and 9-figure DTC brands. This role sits at the intersection of aesthetics and performance, translating CRO strategy, A/B test hypotheses, and brand guidelines into polished, conversion-optimized digital experiences. You will work closely with CRO strategists, developers, and client partners to bring designs from concept to implementation with precision and speed.


What Success Looks Like

  • Measurable improvements in CVR, AOV, and on-site engagement metrics across your client portfolio
  • High-quality design deliverables that are executed on-brief, on-brand, and on deadline
  • A consistent output of test-ready page variations that support an active A/B testing roadmap
  • Strong cross-functional relationships with CRO strategists and developers that accelerate design-to-launch velocity


Responsibilities

  • Design Shopify storefront experiences including homepages, product detail pages, collection pages, and cart/checkout flows optimized for conversion
  • Develop high-converting landing pages for paid media campaigns, promotional offers, and subscription acquisition
  • Translate CRO hypotheses and A/B test briefs into polished, production-ready design mockups using Figma
  • Apply direct response design principles to every deliverable, balancing visual quality with performance intent
  • Collaborate with CRO strategists to understand test objectives, user behavior data, and optimization priorities before beginning design work
  • Iterate rapidly on design concepts based on A/B test results, heatmap analysis, and qualitative feedback
  • Maintain and evolve client-specific design systems and component libraries in Figma to ensure brand consistency at scale
  • Handoff designs to developers with annotated specs, interaction notes, and responsive behavior defined
  • Review implemented pages against design intent and provide precise QA feedback prior to launch
  • Participate in client-facing design reviews and communicate design rationale clearly and professionally
  • Stay current on DTC eCommerce design trends, Shopify theme capabilities, and emerging CRO best practices


Requirements

  • 3+ years of UI design experience, with a portfolio demonstrating Shopify storefront and landing page work for eCommerce brands
  • Expert proficiency in Figma, including component libraries, auto layout, and developer handoff workflows
  • Deep understanding of direct response design principles and how layout, hierarchy, copy placement, and visual cues drive conversion
  • Proven experience designing within or alongside A/B testing frameworks (Intelligems, Convert, VWO, Optimizely, or similar)
  • Strong understanding of responsive design and mobile-first design principles
  • Ability to interpret quantitative data (CVR, bounce rate, scroll depth, heatmaps) and translate insights into design decisions
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to present and defend design decisions to internal teams and client stakeholders


Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with Shopify theme structure, Liquid templating, or experience working directly within Shopify Online Store 2.0
  • Experience with tools such as Hotjar, Microsoft Clarity, Google Optimize, or similar UX research and testing platforms
  • Basic proficiency in HTML/CSS sufficient to support developer QA and minor implementation edits
  • Background in DTC subscription brands or experience designing subscription-specific UX (subscribe-and-save, upsell flows, portal pages)
  • Motion or micro-interaction design experience using Figma prototyping or After Effects


Compensation and Benefits

  • Generous Time Off: Competitive PTO policy and paid holidays to maintain work-life balance
  • Fully Remote: Work from anywhere with flexible hours and a distributed team culture
  • Compensation: Competitive salary commensurate with experience.

title: Engenheiro de IA
description:
Engenheiro de IA


Estamos em busca de um Engenheiro de IA para atuar em uma fábrica de software consolidada, com mais de 30 anos de atuação no mercado , participando da construção e evolução de soluções avançadas baseadas em Inteligência Artificial e GenAI.


Buscamos um profissional com forte base técnica, pensamento científico e capacidade de projetar arquiteturas escaláveis de IA, garantindo qualidade, segurança, rastreabilidade e eficiência no uso de modelos de linguagem e sistemas inteligentes.


Responsabilidades e atribuições:


• Conduzir o método científico em GenAI: formulação de hipóteses, desenho de experimentos, avaliação estatística e tomada de decisão baseada em evidências.

• Projetar e evoluir a arquitetura de IA com foco em RAG/LLMs, escalabilidade, rastreabilidade, explicabilidade, custo e latência.

• Definir, acompanhar e melhorar métricas de qualidade: recuperação (recall/precision, nDCG), factualidade, utilidade, segurança, latência e custo por requisição.

• Elaborar e refinar engenharia de prompts em cenários complexos, com guardrails e práticas de segurança contra prompt injection, exfiltração e jailbreaks.

• Garantir compliance e anonimização de dados sensíveis em linha com LGPD e regulamentações do setor público, com auditoria e trilhas de decisão.

• Documentar experimentos, resultados e boas práticas, promovendo transparência e reprodutibilidade; comunicar insights técnicos e executivos com clareza.

• Evangelizar o uso responsável e eficiente da IA representando a empresa em talks, artigos e comunidades técnicas.


Requisitos e qualificações (obrigatórios):


• Sólida base em Estatística, Probabilidade e ML (regressão, classificação, clusterização) e desenho experimental. Experiência prática com LLMs, engenharia de prompts, embeddings e RAG em produção.

• Python avançado para análises, prototipação e serviços; SQL avançado e engenharia de dados aplicada (ETL/ELT).

• MLOps/LLMOps: experiment tracking (MLflow, W&B ou equivalente), versionamento de dados/modelos/prompts, observabilidade (tracing, custo, latência) e boas práticas de CI/CD.

• Capacidade de comunicar resultados complexos a públicos técnicos e de negócio; experiência prévia como arquiteto de soluções ou líder técnico em projetos de IA.

• Conhecimento em Airflow.


Diferenciais:


• Evals automatizados e guardrails: Ragas, DeepEval, PromptFlow/Promptfoo, LangSmith, NeMo Guardrails, Truera, Rebuff.

• Experiência com IA aplicada ao setor público ou jurídico, incluindo OCR/NLP jurídico e normalização de documentos processuais.

• Contribuições em InnerSource/open source, publicações e talks em comunidades técnicas.

• Otimização de custo/performance de LLMs e técnicas avançadas de RAG (query rewriting, reranking, recuperação híbrida, agentes).


Modelo de Contratação: CLT + Pacote de Benefícios

title: Elementor Expert (WordPress Website Builder)
description:
We are looking for a skilled WordPress developer with strong Elementor experience to join our team and build high-performance websites for our marketing agency clients.


This role focuses on executing a proven build process , not designing sites from scratch. You’ll work from established Elementor Pro templates while inserting pre-generated content and images created by our internal AI systems.


If you enjoy working within clear systems and take pride in building clean, fast, and polished websites , this role will be a great fit.



Responsibilities


  • Build 3–4 WordPress websites per week using pre-built Elementor Pro templates
  • Insert AI-generated content into website layouts (all content is provided)
  • Adjust layouts and design elements to tailor each template for the client
  • Generate website visuals using AI image tools based on supplied prompts
  • Create simple design assets when needed using Canva
  • Integrate WooCommerce functionality for ecommerce websites
  • Ensure each website achieves extremely fast page load speeds (under 1 second)
  • Follow documented build processes and workflows precisely



Required Skills & Experience


  • Advanced proficiency with Elementor and Elementor Pro
  • Strong knowledge of WordPress performance optimization
  • Experience configuring WooCommerce within Elementor websites
  • Familiarity with AI image generation tools (Midjourney, DALL-E, OpenAI, etc.)
  • Basic graphic design ability and experience with Canva
  • Strong English communication skills
  • Available during EST business hours
  • Highly organized and comfortable working within defined processes



What This Role Focuses On


This role is about efficiently producing high-quality websites using a repeatable system .


You will not be responsible for writing content or designing full websites from scratch. Our automation tools generate the text and provide prompts for images. Your job is to assemble the site using templates, produce visuals, refine the layout, and ensure the final result is clean, professional, and extremely fast.



Important Note


⚡ Performance is critical.

Every site must achieve full page load speeds under 1 second without relying on caching solutions.


If you do not have strong experience optimizing WordPress for speed, this role will not be a good fit.



What We Provide


  • Managed hosting accounts
  • Elementor Pro licenses
  • AI-generated content for every site
  • Image prompts for generating visuals
  • Detailed documentation and build processes
  • A steady pipeline of website projects


Full-time role

Working hours: 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM EST (±1 hour flexibility)



Who We’re Looking For


The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, efficient, and process-driven . You take pride in producing polished work, enjoy following clear systems, and understand how small optimizations can dramatically impact website performance.


You’re comfortable using modern tools like AI image generators, you work quickly without sacrificing quality, and you care about delivering websites that are both visually clean and technically fast .

title: Professor de inglês online
description:
A DevSpeak Academy é uma escola especializada no ensino de inglês para profissionais da área de tecnologia. Nosso foco é preparar alunos para se comunicarem com confiança no mercado internacional, em turmas pequenas e com aulas totalmente online.

title: Community Manager

  • Leveraging various platforms and tools such as Salesforce, Salesloft, Chorus, Chili Piper, and more
  • Make a minimum of 40 outbound calls per day as well as send nurture emails promoting our client's value

  • Excellent English communication skills

title: Calculista, Projeto Elétrico Transformadores de Força - Orçamentista
description:
Funcionário, Freelance, Contrato, Terceiro ou Temporário

Remoto, Híbrido ou Presencial

Mínimo 2 anos de experiência na área


Sobre a empresa

A COMTRAFO Indústria de Transformadores Elétricos S.A. é uma empresa brasileira especializada no projeto e fabricação de transformadores de potência para concessionárias e grandes projetos de energia no Brasil e no exterior.

A empresa integra o grupo American Superconductor Corporation (AMSC) , companhia global de tecnologia energética sediada nos Estados Unidos, ampliando sua atuação internacional e capacidade de inovação.

Esse momento de expansão cria oportunidades de desenvolvimento técnico, crescimento profissional e participação em projetos de engenharia de alta complexidade no setor elétrico . ⚡


Descrição da vaga

A COMTRAFO Indústria de Transformadores Elétricos S.A. , empresa do grupo American Superconductor Corporation (AMSC) , busca profissional para atuar como Projetista / Calculista Elétrico de Transformadores de Potência , integrando a área de Orçamentos e Engenharia de Vendas .

O profissional será responsável pelo desenvolvimento de estudos técnicos, dimensionamento e elaboração de propostas para transformadores de potência até 345 kV , destinados ao mercado nacional e internacional , atuando em interface com as áreas de engenharia, comercial e clientes.


Principais atividades:

  • Realizar dimensionamento de transformadores de potência (reatância, perdas, correntes, impedâncias, esforços de curto-circuito, etc.);
  • Elaborar memoriais de cálculo e folhas de dados técnicas para propostas;
  • Analisar especificações técnicas de clientes (ET / RFQ) e normas aplicáveis;
  • Definir configurações técnicas e construtivas dos equipamentos para atendimento às especificações;
  • Apoiar a área comercial na elaboração de propostas técnicas e comerciais ;
  • Interagir com clientes e equipes internas para esclarecimentos técnicos durante o processo de oferta ;
  • Participar da avaliação técnica de riscos e viabilidade de fornecimento .


Perfil desejado:

  • Formação em Engenharia Elétrica ;
  • Conhecimento em transformadores de potência e seus princípios de projeto ;
  • Familiaridade com normas técnicas do setor (IEC / IEEE) ;
  • Capacidade de análise técnica, organização e comunicação com diferentes áreas;
  • Inglês técnico será considerado diferencial.


O profissional terá a oportunidade de atuar em projetos de engenharia para sistemas elétricos de alta complexidade , contribuindo para soluções destinadas a utilities e grandes projetos de energia no Brasil e no exterior . ⚡

title: Data Engineer
description:
Senior Data Engineer (Node.js / TypeScript / GraphQL)

Location: Remote – Brazil or Mexico

Employment Type: Contract

Interview Process: Internal Interview + Client Interview


Role Details

We are looking for a talented senior data engineer specializing in building a highly scalable cloudbased GraphQL API layer to deliver sports and betting data across multiple digital platforms. This role involves creating a seamless and efficient data ingestion processing and delivery system integrating streaming data and highperformance querying.


You’ll work closely with crossfunctional teams to design and implement a federated GraphQL architecture driving the future of sports and betting data integration within the CBS Sports digital ecosystem.


Your Day-to-Day

  • Build new foundational capabilities using domain-driven design and test-driven development that will power features and experiences on various CBS Sports properties
  • Help lead team members in the design development and optimization of our core sports GraphQL subgraphs and services within a federated architecture
  • Participate in scrum ceremonies daily standups grooming and sprint planning
  • Practice DevOps writing good tests and deploying continuously to production with observability and monitoring
  • Review your teammates designs and code providing constructive feedback and engaging in technical discussions including weekly deep dive sessions on various topics
  • Work with product partners to develop technical solutions for features leveraging GraphQL for data integration


Key Projects

  • Building out a GraphQL API for seamless data access and integration across multiple services
  • Designing and building out a core data layer to power all CBS Sports Digital products ingesting processing and storing data from hundreds of sources over different transports and data stores
  • Defining a distributed tracing system for web services and data observability within a GraphQL ecosystem
  • Containerizing core systems to reduce the overhead of infrastructure management


Qualifications

What you bring to the team

You have:

  • 5+ years of experience in data engineering and data system development
  • Experience in designing implementing and maintaining GraphQL schemas optimizing query performance and ensuring seamless data retrieval and manipulation for enhanced user experiences
  • Experience with Javascript TypeScript Python Nodejs
  • Experience with relational NoSQL and keyvalue data stores such as Aurora MySQL DynamoDB MongoDB Redis
  • Hands-on experience working in a distributed cloudbased environment AWS preferred with high transaction volumes using a variety of connected services
  • Proficiency with modern build strategies continuous integration unit testing and automated integration tests GitHub issue tracking tools Jira and CICD related disciplines GitOps
  • Ability to design solutions provide estimates and evaluate risk and technical feasibility
  • BS Computer Science Engineering a related technical degree or equivalent professional experience


You might also have

  • Wundergraph Cosmo or Apollo GraphQL experience
  • AWS Certifications
  • Experience with extract transform load ETL pipelines using data orchestration platforms cloud services and frameworks a plus
  • Experience at an online company in digital media or content creation
  • Excellent team player and communicator capable of creating positive relationships across engineering product and architecture
  • Energetic selfstarter who can work in a complex collaborative environment that rewards innovation initiative curiosity and mentoring
  • Knowledge of sports and gaming

title: Software Engineer
description:
Role Overview

We are looking for a hands‑on Software Engineer to join the Developer Risk (DevRisk) team. You will build data-driven features and services that power developer review and enforcement workflows. The role spans querying large datasets, building back-end services and front-end review UI components, and implementing platform capabilities that improve risk detection and decision-making.

You will collaborate closely with data engineers, product managers, and reviewers to translate business criteria into robust tooling and dashboards, ensuring accuracy, performance, and end‑to‑end reliability.


Key Responsibilities

  • Data Querying & Reporting: Write efficient SQL queries to extract data from the DevRisk Data Warehouse and populate dashboards/spreadsheets to deliver required statistics and insights.
  • Policy & Criteria Improvements: Identify improvements to developer ban criteria based on data analysis and implement corresponding changes in DevRisk tooling and review UI.
  • Frontend (Review UI): Build pages and widgets in the reviewer UI to render critical information for decision-making; ensure usability, consistency, and performance.
  • Backend Services: Design and implement back-end services and APIs to power the review UI and related enforcement workflows.
  • Enforcement Platform: Design and implement platform functionality that enables accurate, auditable, and scalable developer enforcement.
  • Quality & Reliability: Perform end‑to‑end testing, optimization, and integration of implemented services; monitor performance and iterate based on feedback.
  • Documentation: Document data lineage, UI/UX behavior, and service contracts to support operability and governance.


Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
  • Industry experience in software engineering or closely related areas.
  • Proficiency in at least one of C++, Java, or Python.
  • Strong experience with SQL for complex querying and data manipulation.
  • Fluency in English (reading, writing, speaking, and listening).


Preferred Qualifications

  • Proficiency in Java/C++/Python and SQL (multiple languages).
  • Experience with ETL and data pipelines (batch and/or streaming).
  • Hands‑on experience with version control, collaborative code reviews, and automated testing (e.g., Git/Gerrit, CI/CD, unit/integration/e2e testing).
  • Exposure to risk, trust & safety, enforcement systems, or policy tooling is a plus.
  • Familiarity with data modeling, observability (metrics, logging, tracing), and secure coding practices.


Tech Stack (Indicative)

  • Languages: Java, Python, C++
  • Data: SQL, Data Warehouse, ETL/ELT tools, spreadsheets/dashboarding
  • Backend: REST/gRPC services, microservices, authentication/authorization
  • Frontend: Component‑based UI (widgets/pages for reviewer workflows)
  • Testing: Unit, integration, E2E; CI/CD pipelines
  • Ops: Monitoring, alerting, performance tuning


What We’re Looking For

  • Strong problem‑solving skills and a data‑driven mindset.

Fundado em 1986, seu âmbito comercial abrange tubulações, materiais de construção para o lar, proteção ambiental, novas energias e plataformas de serviços de cadeia de suprimentos. Os produtos incluem tubulações, energia solar fotovoltaica, canalizações e banheiros, cozinhas integradas, portas e janelas integradas, cofragens de alumínio e andaimes inteligentes, equipamentos de purificação de água, impermeabilizantes e selantes, equipamentos contra incêndios, válvulas, cabos elétricos, iluminação, materiais sanitários, proteção ambiental, instalações agrícolas, redes de gaiolas marinhas para aquicultura, entre outros campos. Em 2023, a receita operacional do Grupo atingiu 4,38 bilhões de dólares.


Resumo da Vaga

Estamos expandindo nossa equipe de vendas e estamos procurando um REPRESENTANTE DE VENDAS EXTERNO motivado no Brasil para ajudar a acelerar o crescimento na sua região designada. 2.Visitar proativamente clientes potenciais e desenvolver novas oportunidades de negócio.

4.Coletar e encaminhar leads qualificados de clientes e projetos para a gerência e para a matriz.

5.Manter o relacionamento com os clientes existentes e apoiar a reincidência de negócios.

7.Alcançar os KPIs atribuídos relacionados a visitas a clientes, prospecção e suporte de vendas.

title: Senior DevOps Engineer / Architect
description:
Senior DevOps Engineer / Architect


Location: Remote (Brazil)



About Sphise Technologies


Sphise Technologies is a global outsourcing and talent solutions company, partnering with high-growth businesses to build strong, high-impact teams across finance, technology, and operations. Our trusted technology partner is scaling a modern cloud platform and is seeking a Senior DevOps Engineer / Architect to lead infrastructure strategy and DevOps practices. As the platform continues to grow, this role will be instrumental in building scalable cloud infrastructure, strengthening CI/CD pipelines, and ensuring the platform remains secure, reliable, and cost-efficient.


Position Overview


We are looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer or Architect who will take ownership of infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud operations. You will play a critical role in ensuring the platform is scalable, secure, and reliable while optimizing performance and cloud cost efficiency.

This position requires a hands-on technical leader who can collaborate closely with engineering, security, and product teams while mentoring developers on DevOps culture and tooling.



What You'll Do:


  • Design, build, and maintain infrastructure using Terraform , ensuring reproducible and version-controlled environments.
  • Own and manage Azure cloud infrastructure including networking, compute, storage, identity, and platform services.
  • Architect and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions for applications built with .NET, PHP, Node.js, React, and Next.js.
  • Implement best practices in pipeline automation, testing integration, artifact management, and deployment workflows .
  • Strengthen platform security by implementing IAM best practices, secrets management, network segmentation, and encryption strategies .
  • Integrate security scanning tools (SAST/DAST/SCA) and compliance checks into infrastructure and deployment pipelines.
  • Build and maintain observability using DataDog and SolarWinds , including monitoring, logging, dashboards, and alerts.
  • Define reliability standards including SLOs, SLIs, and incident response runbooks .
  • Optimize cloud infrastructure costs through resource tagging, autoscaling strategies, reserved capacity planning, and cost monitoring dashboards .
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to promote DevOps culture, automation, and self-service capabilities .



What You Bring:


  • 5+ years of experience in DevOps, Platform Engineering, or Site Reliability Engineering.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure cloud infrastructure .
  • Deep expertise with Terraform and infrastructure-as-code practices .
  • Proven experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions .
  • Strong understanding of cloud security practices , including IAM, secrets management, and vulnerability scanning.
  • Experience with Cloudflare services such as CDN, WAF, DNS, and Zero Trust.
  • Strong Linux administration and scripting experience (Bash, Python, or PowerShell ).
  • Experience working with SQL Server in cloud environments .
  • Hands-on experience with monitoring and observability tools such as DataDog or SolarWinds .
  • Strong communication and documentation skills.



Nice to Have

  • Experience with AWS infrastructure such as EC2, S3, RDS, IAM, EKS, or Lambda.
  • Experience with Databricks or modern data platform infrastructure .
  • Familiarity with policy-as-code frameworks such as OPA, Sentinel, or Azure Policy.
  • Experience working with Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, or container security practices .
  • Knowledge of FinOps practices and cloud cost optimization strategies .
  • Experience implementing SRE methodologies such as SLOs and error budgets .



What We Offer:

  • Competitive compensation package aligned with senior-level expertise.
  • Fully remote work environment with flexible collaboration across global teams.
  • The opportunity to shape and lead the DevOps architecture of a growing cloud platform.
  • Work with modern cloud technologies and engineering best practices .
  • A collaborative, engineering-focused culture with high ownership and impact .
  • Opportunities for professional development, certifications, and technical growth .
